QuestInfo.1:
Adonis gave me my first task, to go see Chumji in Korean Folk Town. He explained that it will not be easy to follow the road through this perilous journey to obtain the item I am after.
Turning back is still an option, but it leaves me to face the treacherous road over the lava.
QuestInfo.2:
Adonis gave me my first task, to go see Chumji in Korean Folk Town. He explained that it will not be easy to follow the road through this perilous journey to obtain the item I am after.
Turning back is still an option, but it leaves me to face the treacherous road over the lava.
QuestInfo.name: The Long Road Begins

npc.0: Did you speak with Chumji? He might be able to help you...

QuestInfo.1: When I told Chumji, the Elder in Korean Folk Town, that Adonis of El Nath had sent me, his first reaction was not too promising. I managed to calm him down eventually, and when he listened to what I had to say about the Dead Mine, something that could resemble curiousity glimmered in his eyes. We struck a deal, I would prove to him that magic was real, by bringing him the flame of whatever blue lights the villagers had been seeing in the woods outside of Korean Folk Town, and in return he promised to help me on my journey to finding the item I'm after.
QuestInfo.2: Chumji could not tell me how to trap the flame in a safe container, but he did give me the name of someone who might: Chun Ji of Victoria Island. He has allegedly mastered both the flame and the sword... and while I was told to tread lightly around him, he could be the key to finding a way to seal the flame. Now where might I find Chun Ji...?
QuestInfo.name: Helping Chumji

item.0: Did you find the source of the blue lights yet? I doubt the rumors are true...

QuestInfo.name: Chumji's Advice

npc.0: Talk with Chun Ji. But remember, choose your words wisely around him...

QuestInfo.0: Chun Ji admitted to having forgotten the ancient ritual required to seal the flame. He told me to go see The Rememberer and ask for the relevant details... Where will this journey end?
QuestInfo.1: After Chun Ji admitted to having forgotten the ancient ritual required to seal the flame, he told me to go see The Rememberer and ask for the relevant details. Unfortunately, The Rememberer in his stubbornness, insisted that Chun Ji must remember on his own, if he is to further his mental capabilities. He told me that I could aid Chun Ji in remembering by bringing a special item that was lost to the fire-breathing drakes up in the rocky mountains... If only he'd told me more...
QuestInfo.2: Chun Ji was eager to hear what I had learned from The Remberer, so when I broke the news that I had received no guidance he was sorely disappointed... His mood quickly swinged around though, when I revealed to him the item I had found up in Perion! The Rememberer said that this relic could help Chun Ji recover his lost memories... I should talk to Chun Ji again to see what he has learned...
QuestInfo.name: The Sealing of the Flame

QuestInfo.1:
The ring I brought to Chun Ji had a small inscription on it that contained vital information on how to perform the ritual needed to create the base for The Breath of Lava. However, Chun Ji lacked both the ingredients for the procedure and the container that will hold the substance. He told me to locate Porter in Omega Sector for tips on how to forge a container strong enough to hold such a liquid, and Carson of the Zenumist Society to ask him if he could help me create the inert substance that Chun Ji plans to mix with the fire.

QuestInfo.1: The flame has finally been sealed in the special container! It was anything but easy, but it is finally done... However, Chun Ji told me that the Breath of Lava is powerless as long as it lacks its most important component. The final ingredient; the element of magic. He told me to seek out the Sea Witch Carta and ask her kindly to perform this last ritual upon the bottle with The Breath of Lava, to give it its magical powers.

QuestInfo.0: Let's look for Manji in Perion
QuestInfo.1: I ran into Manji from Perion again, the same Manji that I met while I was helping the little Maya get her medicine. He was shocked by my stronger appearance, and wanted to ask me for a favor. Long long ago, he was in danger of being attacked by Balrog, only to be saved by the legendary hero Tristan. He died in place of Manji, and for that, he's been keeping that sword to this day. Too bad the sword has been soaked in Balrog's evilness and is as ragged as possible. It's too embarrassing to even call it a sword now. Anyway, he gave me the #rOld Gladius#k and wanted me to reawaken it for him. If it indeed gets reawaken, it becomes the #bHero's Gladius#k ...I should go see Chrishrama of Sleepywood just the way Manji said it...
QuestInfo.2: It seems that this Gladius which Manji told me is one fine sword. I had to make a hard decision choosing one bwtween the #bGladius#k and the #bSkull Earring#k which Manji offered me, but I will not regret.
QuestInfo.name: Hero's Gladius
QuestInfo.summary: I need to rewaken the Hero's Gladius and take it to Manji.

0.0: Ok so who's bothering me now ... hey!! You have a knack for annoying me even at the best of times ... well, that's alright. If you have indeed gotten that much stronger, then I'd like to see it firsthand. Did you put #t4031005# to good use? Well, it's all in the past, so ...
0.1: I would like you to help me out once. Of course, I can take care of it myself, but I can't leave this area. What do you think ...? You seem to have gotten strong enough to handle it easily ... will you take a crack at it?

yes.0: Good decision. A few decades ago, I went into a huge cave in the middle of this island. In there I felt this force of evil only I could feel, and I was sucked into it, following it deeper into the cave ... I felt a sense of danger inside but that didn't prevent me from walking further into the cave.
yes.1: By the time I regained consciousness, everything around me was blue. And in the middle of darkness I saw a pair of piercing eyes staring at me. He was ... yeah, the mythical, legendary Balrog. Possessing a huge set of wings and the teeth so sharp it could have cut through anything ...
yes.2: I've spent all my life fighting, but his presence was undeniably overwhelming. My mind was telling me it was impossible to beat him, but it was already right in front of me. His weighty tail went up, high up ... and starting moving towards me!
yes.3: Right at that second, someone stood in my way. This man, with a mysterious aura around his sword, fought Balrog straight up, enabling me to escape. After rescuing me, he was struck by Balrog's teeth and fell down the cliff. He was ... yes, the hero of legendary proportion, Tristan.
yes.4: I went all the way down to where he ultimately fell. He didn't look like he had much of a chance. Before it was too late, he handed me the #b#t1302014##k, by then worn-out by the sheer evil of Balrog, and then passed away. This is that same sword right here. I would love to restore this to its original state.
yes.5: The sword becomes #b#t1302015##k once it is reawaken. However, as for the details of how to reawaken it, I have no idea. I think you have to eliminate the evil force of Balrog, though ... You should go see #p1061000# from #m105040300# and ask about it.

QuestInfo.1: At Ellinia, I ran into a fairy that's been busily studying the magic of life. Her name is "Mar" and after taking a look at my pet that's been turned into a doll, she told me she can make it come back alive with #bThe Water of Life#k and #bThe Scroll of Life#k. I heard that she knows Cloy of Henesys... since it looks like a pet trainer named #bTrainer Bartos#k of Henesys knows something about the scroll of life, I should head over there...
QuestInfo.2: After easily passing the test from Trainer Bartos of Henesys, I got a hold of #bThe Water of Life#k and #bThe Scroll of Lifel#k, and got that to "Mar" the fairy. yes.1: You see nearly 20 years ago Manji, Tristan and myself faced The Prince of Darkness Balrog as an expedition of three adventurers, however things went horribly wrong as Balrog was starting to overpower our party...
yes.2: Our leader Tristan the Hero sacrificed himself to buy us time and provide the required energy to seal the Balrog. Other than my comrade, I also lost an eye in that battle.
yes.3: While we did manage to seal Balrog and escaped together, we knew we had to deliver the bad news to Tristan's pregnant wife.
yes.4: Manji said he would do it as he was the chosen godfather for the child. Speaking of Manji, you should let him know the seal won't hold out any longer and we need him here! Although he may not simply take your word for it so check with his apprentice Mu Young on how to bring Manji the news.

npc.0: Please look for any individuals upstairs and report back to me.

yes.1: Head over to Eos Tower and you'll see a monster called #b#o3110102##k. Take them out and please gather up #b10 #t4031129#s#k. Their cheese is supposed to be top-notch. I feel like I can make the best soup in the world with that chesse, you know? Well, good luck~~

yes.0: Do you like the #b100 #t2020004#s#k that I gave you? Now that I've gotten the ingredients and all, I'll have to start working on this soup. yes.0: Thank you so much~! This one's also on the fact that I don't have anything to cook with at home. My dad works everyday, and I want to make something healthy as well as delicious for his lunch today, but I have nothing to work with at home. yes.1: Head over to Eos Tower and you'll see a monster called #b#o3230308##k hanging around at the outer wall. They cough up #t4000116#, so please gather up #b 15 #t4000116#s#k. They are full inside, and tasty like no other. It can be used on a variety of dishes, so ... good luck!

no.0: I see ... you must be swamped with other things yourself. If you ever find some time, then please come talk to me. I can always use some help, you know~

yes.0: Do you like the #b#t1032006##k? Now that I have the ingredients ready, I'll have to get back to cooking now. I can literally see my dad drooling over this as we speak. Thank you so much for you help. I'll have to go now. See you around!

item.0: I don't think you have the stuff I asked for, yet. Defeat the #b#o3230308#s#k, who are usually located at the outer wall of Eos Tower, and collect #b15 #t4000116#s#k in the process. That will make me look like a great cook in a hurry!

QuestInfo.1: I met up with Nemi again at a small house in Ludibrium. Lately she had been experiencing some weird things where the food had been disappearing right after being made, and was suspecting that the rats might have done it. That's why there's a toy mouse called Ratz, which is a toy mouse with rat traps, but instead of catching rats, they became alive as monsters. At Nemi's request, I'll have to take out Ratz and collect #b45 Rat traps#k, and give them back to her.\n\n#t4000095# #b#c4000095##k/45
QuestInfo.2: I collected all the rat traps that Nemi needed in Ludibrium. I can't believe the amount of rat traps she made, judging from the fact that every single Ratz in Eos Tower is her creation.
QuestInfo.name: Nemi's Dilemma

0.0: Oh no... what should I do... oh hi!! You came by again! I have run into yet another problem. I am so sorry that I keep asking you for favors, but I seriously can't find a way to wiggle out of this by myself. Can you help me out...?

yes.0: Thank you. I am sure you're terribly busy but still. Well, here's a problem. It has happened before, but it has happened much more often lately. Every time I make food, it disappears. I am sure it's the rats, but I can't prove it.
yes.1: I work hard at making the best food possible, and as soon as I leave, even for a few minutes, the food just disappears. It's so disheartening. The thing is ... this has happened before, and because of that, I got some #o3110102#s as a toy rat, and I set up rat traps on them to catch rats.
yes.2: But as you can see, they have since turned into monsters and are attacking people now. It's all my fault... and because of that... can you go back to Eos Tower and defeat #b#o3110102##k? Please gather up #b45 #t4000095#s#k afterwards, and do it ASAP. Thank you.

no.0: I see ... you must be swamped with other things yourself. If you ever find some time, then please come talk to me. I can always use some help, you know~

yes.0: Do you like the hat that I gave you? I've been saving up the hat in case I venture outside Ludibrium, but it looks like you need it more than I do right now. Now I'll have to set these traps up before making the dinner. I'll see you around!

item.0: Please head over to Eos Tower and collect #b45 #t4000095#s#k by defeating the #b#o3110102##k so I can chase off the rats from my food. I'll have to get the #t4000095#s back from the rats. Thanks again!

0.0: How's the Toy Factory operating these days? It concerns me a great deal that the majority of the workforce is here fixing up the tower as opposed to working at the factory. I really wish I could take care of both the work at the factory and the work here.
0.1: That's why... I'd like to ask you for a favor. Not far from where we are, at the 60th floor, you'll run into a whole bunch of #b#o3230400#s#k. They used to be just cute and cuddly, but lately, they are mad and ready to fight these days.
0.2: I don't know what makes them want to stop us from fixing up this tower, but it has reached the point where I can't just sit back and look at them destroy the place. That's why... I'd like to ask you to "take care of" some of the #b#o3230400#s#k. Can you do that for me?

yes.0: It pains me to kill these previously-adorable creatures, but it has to be done. Please take care of them and bring back #b100 #t4000127#s#k as evidence. If you do this well, I may ask you for more help down the road.
yes.1: Oh, and ... #b#p2050008##k of the Omega Sector may know a thing or two about #b#o3230400##k causing commotion here. I suggest you pay a visit to the General before killing them. Good luck~!

no.0: I see... I thought I could count on you to take care of them. Maybe it's too overwhelming for you to kill those cute little monsters. Maybe it's just too much to ask. In any case, if you decide to change your mind, please come talk to me.

1.0: Thanks to your help defeating the #o3230400#s, the fixing of the tower has gotten much easier now. You're much stronger than I thought. Anyway, with great work comes great reward. This may not be much, but please take it. I know it'll help you in some way shape or form.

yes.0: Did you receive #b12,000 mesos#k? Anyway, I seriously hope that those guys return to their original, adorable state. 0.1: I have recovered, but there's another set of problems killing me now. Some random, unqualified monsters are the ones opening up the Clocktower, and ruining things. My workers are also not doing so well right now... because of this, I'll need your help one more time.

yes.0: I can't believe you said yes! Well, here's the details. There have been monsters contaminated with the dark force that seems to emanate here, and one of the worst seems to be #b#o3210207##k, but I can't do a thing about it.
yes.1: They use their small bodies to penetrate their way into the huge clock and cause all kinds of troubles this way. The clock is vulnerable in multiple spots to begin with, and they tend to attack in bunches, so the workers have a hard time fixing it. That's why...
yes.2: Please take down #b80 #o3210207#s#k that should be around here. It'll be better for us if they just decrease in numbers. #o3210207# is a bug-like monster that has a clock on its back, so it won't be hard to locate it.

no.0: We need your help desperately. Who am I going to ask for this ... if you have a change of heart, then please talk to me

1.0: What took you so long!! I've been waiting for you here. From what I've heard, you took care of the #b80 #o3210207#s#k just the way you promised. It may have taken you some time, but we're more than thankful for helping us. Here's a small present for your hard work.

yes.0: Do you like the #b120 #t2000010#s#k that I gave you? Thank you so much for all your help. Now that the #b#o3210207#s#k are much lesser than they were before, I hope they don't go in the clock of Clocktower and destroy things anymore. There are still lots of problems that remain unsolved, though. I'll be here waiting for you.

mob.0: Please take out a 100 #b#o3210207#s#k, the number 1 reason for all those nicks and bruises the clock takes.

QuestInfo.0: I should check on #p2040029#, who is working hard at the Lost Time.
QuestInfo.1: I met up with #p2040029# deep inside the abandoned time of Ludibrium. #p2040029# admitted since he's an old fella, the spring was needed to rewind himself back to life, but the younger clock workers these days are all battery-operated, only to have some of them not have adequate batteries and thus not working the way it should be. I should collect #b200 cheap batteries#k for the sake of those clocks in need of them. \n\n#t4000111# #b#c4000111##k/200
QuestInfo.2: I got the cheap batteries needed for the new battery-operated worker clocks. #p2040029# seemed ecstatic over the prospect of those workers finally showing life and lessening his work burden in the process. Anyway, what exactly are they doing in there...?
QuestInfo.name: The Clock Workers' Batteries

0.0: You're the one that took care of the annoying ones the other day, but what are you doing here on a dangerous spot like this? We're here for work, but this floor is full of monsters contaminated by evil force, and you may not get out of here healthy.
0.1: Hmm, but then again, if you're here in the first place, then you're strong enough. We've been looking for someone that can help us in our journey, and it's you! You might be busy taking care of other things, too, but please set aside some time for us. Please...?

yes.0: Thanks! As you may know, this place is pretty abandoned, but a lot of the workers are here on special duties. I can move around with the old-school spring being rewound, but most of the new workers are operated in batteries.
yes.1: But we've also been lacking batteries to the point where some workers cannot even perform expected duties because of the lack of power. The worst thing that can happen is for each and every one of us to freeze altogether. I don't even want to think of the possibilities.
yes.2: Please gather up #b200 #t4000111#s#k so the workers here can work much better. From what I have heard, the monster that most resembles a robot inside the Toy Factory has it.

no.0: Sigh ... this is precisely the time when we need your help. Who are we going to ask for...????

1.0: You're back!!! Let's see... yeah, it is indeed the #b200 #t4000111#s#l. There were quite a few workers on the verge of stopping, but I'm glad that won't be the case anymore. Here's a small sign of our appreciation for your hard work.

yes.0: Alright, the batteries are gong to be in. now. Thanks for your hard work. Thank you. Thank you. Hopefully you'll make it to the bottom safely!

yes.1: 뭐? 이곳에서 계속 신발을 수리하던 것 아니냐구? 이것 보시게, 나도 사람이네. 한 곳에 그렇게 오래 앉아 있을 수만은 없지 않은가? 짬이 날 때마다 나만 알고 있는 샛길로 이곳 저곳 다니곤 하는데 마침 이걸 발견하고는 한 눈에 내가 자네에게 준 것이라고 알아 보았지.

no.0: 뭐, 문제가 없다면 다행이고... 이곳의 날씨는 매우 추우니 감기에 걸리지 않도록 조심하게. 모험가에게는 건강이 제일 중요하니깐 말일세.

QuestInfo.0: Oh my gosh... I wound up losing #b#t1122013##k! I swear I kept it with me, but while I looked away, I wound up... misplacing it. Sigh, there's nothing I can do, I better just visit #b#p2020002##k and tell him what happened. Do I really have to go to #b#m211000100##k and face the music?
QuestInfo.1: He knew I had misplaced it? He picked it up from the streets? I was shocked to hear what #b#p2020002##k told me. Honestly, losing it really made me feel guilty about it, but at least it's back in my hands now! Phew... I'll need to start another conversation with him.
QuestInfo.2: I really didn't see it coming. I was totally unaware that he had left #b#m211000100##k and was watching me from the back... thankfully, #p2020002# had the item with him, and he just gave me back the item without much of a lecture. I felt so bad and embarassed that I vowed never to misplace the item ever again.
QuestInfo.name: Gordon's Warm Heart

0.0: Hmmm? What concerns you? You don't look too well by any means. If you have something in mind, talk to me.

yes.0: Oh... so you lost the Magic ?? I gave you. Hah... the truth is, I knew you did. I actually picked it up from the streets, and I had been holding on to it, hoping that you will one day come pick it up.
yes.1: Even I can't stay in one place for too long. My body was aching and I need a long walk every now and then to stretch out. It was one of those long-walk days when I found the ??, and I immediately recognized it as the one I gave to you. \nTalk to me in a bit. I'll need to find it first so I can give it to you...

no.0: Well, if nothing concerns you, then that's good. It's really cold in here, and I urge you to take care of your body. Health is of utmost importance for explorers like you.

1.0: Oh I found it! It looks a bit dirtier than when I last gave it to you. Do you not take care of this? That's unfortunate. When I was using this, there was nary a scratch on this ??. Here, take it.

yes.0: Promise me that you will never lose it again. I want you to take care of it as much as I did. Understood? If you run into a nother problem, then feel free to let me know. I'll try to help you as much as I can.

item.0: What? You lost it?

QuestInfo.0: Chief Stan wants to ask me for something... I wonder what it is...
QuestInfo.1: I met with #bChief Stan#k, who was at Henesys in Victoria Island. He handed me what appeared to be an old, sealed letter, and wanted me to deliver it to Dr. Kim of Omega Sector. He said to get to Omega Sector, I'll need to first get on board on a ship ride from Ellinia to Orbis, followed by the ride to Ludibrium from there.
QuestInfo.2: I met Dr. Kim at Omega Sector, and handed him the #bsealed letter#k that Chief Stan gave me. This place seems to be full of facilities designed in anticipation of the alien invasion... I should talk to Dr. Kim whenever I have a chance...
QuestInfo.name: Chief Stan's Letter

0.0: Hoh... I've been looking for someone like you. Great! The thing is, someone from this town picked up this letter from the streets that seems to be very dangerous. He didn't know what to do with it, so he gave it to me, but this looks like something that should be sent somewhere, and I really hope you can be the delivery person for me. What do you think ... would you like to do it?

yes.0: Great! Please give this letter to the person written here. My eyes may have failed me, but I can read this, and it says #b#p2050001# of Omega Sector#k. I have never heard of a person like this, but I'm sure someone like you that likes to travel all over the world may be able to run into that person...
yes.1: Go to Ellinia and board on the ship to Orbis, after which you should board on the ship to Ludibrium. Here's hoping you can get this letter to the right person. I'll see you around!

no.0: I guess you don't feel comfortable handling a strange letter like this. If you ever change your mind, however, please talk to me. This letter concerns me more than it should.

1.0: Hmmm... nothing wrong with the machine, as is the fuel, the gas, etc. Hmm, so I need to debug this critical error on the alpha system, and ... hmmm? Can I help you? What? You received a letter from a place far far away and brought it all the way here? Is that so? Then let's see...
1.1: Oh ho... I didn't think I'd receive the much-anticipated #b#t4031099##k from a total stranger like you. So you brought this here all the way from that place? Thank you so much. I'll have to reward you for your work bringing it here. It's not much, but I hope this helps you on your journey.

yes.0: Hmmm ... this is a very interesting material, indeed. A letter from an unknown, living thing from a place far far away... I guess it was aware of my existence from all the way there, but I don't think it knew the exact place I am in. I'll have to study this letter more. Please, make yourself at home.

npc.0: Please give #b#t4031099##k to #b#p2050001# of Omega Sector#k, then board on the ship that heads to Orbis. After that, get on board to the ship that heads to Ludibrium, and you'll be fine! Here's hoping you deliver the letter to the right person. I'll see you around~!

item.0: Hmmm... where exactly is the #b#t4031099##k? I think you might have lost it on your way here. I'm sorry, but I'm very busy conducting a new project as we speak, so you'll have to excuse me for this. Oh, and please don't touch any of the machines here at Omega Sector HQ. Now, if you'll excuse me...

lost.0: Oh no ... did you lose the #b#t4031099##k that I gave you, by any chance? You should have been more careful. Thankfully, someone from this town picked it up from the streets, so I'll give this to you again. Please don't lose it this time, however. Now, please deliver #t4031099# to #p2050001#, who should be at the Omega Sector.

QuestInfo.0: Dr. Kim of Omega Sector has apparently come up with something incredible...
QuestInfo.1: Dr. Kim of Omega Sector gave me the Blueprint Machine for the new robot that's currently in development, and he requested that I show this to Chury, Hoony, and Gunny. I should meet up with #bChury#k first; he's at the #bOmega Sector Silo#k.
QuestInfo.2: Dr. Kim gave me a mission to show Chury the blueprint of the new robot that he's currently making, and I did just that. Chury seemed impressed by it.
QuestInfo.name: Dr. Kim's Comments : Blueprint for New Robot

0.0: Hmmm ... done! The #b#t4031100##k, which contains the blueprint of the new robot, is now COMPLETE! Hahaha!! Once the making of the robot is complete, straight out of this blueprint, the aliens outside the sector will be of no factor whatsoever! Yes... hey you! You look like you don't have much to do. Can you do me a favor?

yes.0: Thank you! I'll give you this #b#t4031100##k. Your job is to show this to #b#p2050005#, #p2050006#, and #p2050007##k. They should be all over Omega Sector. The first person you'll need to meet is #p2050005#. He should be resting somewhere around the Silo.

no.0: Did you feel irked when I said you look like you don't have much to do? I know a whole bunch of people just like you... hmmm... anyway, if you change your mind, talk to me. I am well aware that you really don't have much to do right now.

1.0: Hoh... so this is #b#t4031100##k, the blueprint for the new robot that #b#p2050001##k had been diligently working on for the past few months. Hmmm... so when I put my eyes right there, I can see the contents inside, just for a security measure. Amazing, just the kind of stuff that he would make. Okay, now let's see what's inside this baby...

npc.0: Please take this #b#t4031100##k to #b#p2050005#, #p2050006#, and #p2050007##k, who should be spread out all over Omega Sector, and show them what's inside. I want to give them the good news ASAP. The first person you'll need to see is #p2050005#. He should be around the Silo taking a rest.

item.0: Hmmm... are you saying that #b#p2050001##k has completed the #b#t4031100##k of the new robot? But where is the #t4031100#? Maybe you lost it on the way here... if so, then please go back to #p2050001#. He put a security device on that baby just in case something like this happened.

lost.0: Oh no... did you lose the #b#t4031100##k that I gave you, by any chance? You should have been more careful!! What would have happened if an alien gets a hand on this? Hmmm... good thing I put an automatic-returning device on #b#t4031100##k , in case something like this happened. I'll give you this one more time, so please show it to #b#p2050005#, #p2050006#, #p2050007##k

QuestInfo.1: I met Chury at the Silo of the Omega Sector and showed him the #bBlueprint Machine#k, which contains the blueprint of the new robot, that I got from Dr. Kim. Chury wanted to show this to Hoony, so he asked me if I could show the Blueprint Machine to Hoony, as well as provide him with #b20 Space Foods#k, for he had been away at the Field for a while. Space Food, huh... I think I can find them through Barnard Gray the alien. I'll run into on the way to the Field. \n\n#t4000117# #b#c4000117##k/20
QuestInfo.2: I met up with Chury somewhere around the Omega Sector Silo. Chury wanted me to show the Blueprint Machine to Hoony, as well as give him some food. In turn, I gave Hoony some Space Food to last him a while, and showed him the Blueprint Machine.
QuestInfo.name: Dr. Kim's Comments : A Meeting with Chury

0.0: Ohhh... this is just incredible! I can't believe he drew up a robot as technologically advanced as this! I knew he was incredible to begin with, but... wow!!! He's much more than I thought! Anyway, please take this #b#t4031100##k and show it to #b#p2050006##k, who should be at a field around Omega Sector. I bet you he'll be just as astounded looking at it as I am right now.
0.1: Oh, and... #b#p2050006##k ... he's been out on a mission for a while now and I'm pretty sure he's run out of food as we speak. Please gather up #b20 #t4000117#s#k, which can be found through #b#o4230116##k the alien, and give them to him. Good luck!

1.0: Hoh... #b#t4000117##k!!! Great timing, because I've just ran out of food, and I'm still in the middle of a mission. Can you give me the #t4000117#s? I'll need to fill my belly up first before I check out the #b#t4031100##k or anything else for that matter.

npc.0: Please take the #b#t4031100##k that #b#p2050001##k gave you, along with the 20 #b#t4000117#s#k that can be found through #b#o4230116##k, and give them to #b#p2050006##k, who should be around a field in Omega Sector. He's probably crazy hungry right now, so please find him ASAP.

item.0: Hmmm... are you sure you have #b20 #t4000117#s#k? Or is your etc. inventory full by any chance? Please check your item inventory one more time.

QuestInfo.1: I met Hoony at a Field around Omega Sector, and showed him the #bBlueprint Machine#k, as well as provide him with #b20 Space Foods#k. QuestInfo.2: Hoony wanted to show the Blueprint to Gunny. He was already on his way to give Gunny a new weapon, so he asked me if I could give him the new gun, as well as show him the Blueprint. After much searching around, I was able to finally find him and gave him the gun.
QuestInfo.name: Dr. Kim's Comments : A Meeting with Hoony

0.0: Phew... I feel much better now. But #b#t4031100##k is really amazing! I really want to show #b#p2050007##k this... please find him somewhere around the fields. Oh, and please give him the #b#t4031101##k that I just gave you, too. He told me it was broken, so I fixed it for him.

1.0: Oh wow, you have my #b#t4031101##k! I am guessing you ran into #b#p2050006##k first. Anyway, it's been tough for me to handle all these aliens by myself. Now, let's see if this gun is fixed right.

yes.0: Whoa... this #b#t4031101##k ... it seems like it's actually working better than it did before it broke. And this... this must be the #b#t4031100##k  of the new robot that #b#p2050001##k had been working so hard on. This is incredible!! I truly believe with this robot, the aliens will be much easier to handle.

npc.0: Please find #b#p2050007##k around the fields, and show him the #b#t4031100##k that #b#p2050001##k gave you, as well as the #b#t4031101##k that I promised to fix for him. I'm sure he's having problems fighting the aliens without his main weapon.

item.0: Well, I was sent here on a mission, and one day, my precious #b#t4031101##k broke down on me. I gave it to #b#t2050006##k so he can fix it up quickly, but I'm guessing the fixing has taken longer than expected, and thus, I do not have a weapon to defend myself with. It's quite dangerous around here without a trusty weapon... I hope I can get that really soon...

lost.0: Oh no... did you lose either the #b#t4031101##k or #bBlueprint Machine#k that I gave you, by any chance? Good thing I put automatic-returning devices on both of them in case something like this happened. I'll give you another chance, so please show it to #b#p2050007##k the #b#t4031101##k as well as #b#t4031100##k .

QuestInfo.1: I met up with Gunny at a field around Omega Sector, handed him his #bLaser gun#k, and showed him the #bBlueprint Machine#k. Gunny appreciated my effort and requested that I report this all to Dr. Kim. This Command Center warp capsule seems like a useful item.
QuestInfo.2: As Dr. Kim requested from the Command Center in the Omega Sector, I showed the blueprint of the new robot to Chury, Hoony, and Gunny, while simultaneously solving their problems. Dr. Kim was very pleased with the results, and wanted me to drop by again sometime, for he could use my help.
QuestInfo.name: Dr. Kim's Comments : A Meeting with Gunny

0.0: Must have been tough for you to show all 3 of us the #b#t4031100##k. All you need to do now is to report all this to #b#p2050001##k. The #b#t2030011##k that I just gave you is an item that allows you to teleport straight to the Command Center in Omega Sector. This will help you report this much easier.

1.0: Oh ho... you must have met #b#p2050005#, #p2050006#, and #p2050007##k and showed them #b#t4031100##k. How did they react to it? Were they happy to see it? Hahaha... that was good to know. Now, since you helped us out a great deal, here's a small reward for your job well done. I know it isn't much, but please take it.

yes.0: Did you get the #b12,000 Mesos#k? I also raised your fame level a little bit. It's only fair that your reputation improves after the great job you did. I may need your help again down the road, so please drop by from time to time again.

npc.0: Great work showing all 3 of us the #b#t4031100##k! Now all you need to do is report all this to #b#p2050001##k. Use the #b#t2030011##k that I gave you to teleport straight to the Command Center in the Omega Sector. Good luck~!

QuestInfo.0: I should go see Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.
QuestInfo.1: From the Command Center in the Omega Sector, Dr. Kim requested that I receive 3 important mechanical parts from Cheng the Assistant at the Toy Factory of Ludibrium. Man ... when am I going to find time to go all the way up to Ludibrium?
QuestInfo.2: Dr. Kim of the Command Center in the Omega Sector gave me a mission to receive some stuff from Cheng the Assistant of the Toy Factory. The parts I received seem to be very important for something.

0.0: Glad you are here... thanks to you, the designing of the new robot is complete, and I've started the process of actually making it. Then I realized, we were missing 3 very important mechanical parts necessary to build the robot. I've already given #b#p2040003##k of Ludibrium the word, so can you please go there and pick up the pieces for me? Thank you!

npc.0: I don't think you've met #b#p2040003##k yet. I asked #p2040003# for the parts, so all you need to do is go there and pick them up for me. #b#p2040003##k is located somewhere around the Ludibrium Toy Factory. I'll be waiting for you here.

QuestInfo.1: I met with Cheng the Assistant at the Toy Factory in Ludibrium, and he handed me 3 boxes full of robotic parts, which will be used to make the robot. Now I should just hand them over to Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.
QuestInfo.2: At the Toy Factory in Ludibrium, Cheng the Assistant gave me 3 boxes of robotic parts so I could deliver them to Dr. Kim of the Command Center in the Omega Sector. After delivering the goods to Dr. Kim, he gave me a Warp Capsule, which will enable me to transport to Ludibrium in an instant. Hmmm... this looks like something I can use!
QuestInfo.name: Delivering the Robotic Parts

0.0: Hmmm...? Ohhhh~ #b#p2050001##k already told me about it, through a special device that connects Ludibrium and Omega Sector. The 3 Boxes of Parts that #p2050001# requested are ready here. I'll give those to you, but first make sure to have 3 slots of your etc. inventory available.

yes.0: So you got the 3 Boxes of Parts, right? All these Boxes of Parts contain machines that are very sensitive to pressure, so it may break on you easily. Make sure not to get ambushed by monsters on your way back to the Omega Sector, but I'm sure you can handle it just fine. I'll see you around~

1.0: Ohhh, this is it! These 3 Boxes of Parts are essential in trying to create an important device for the robot. This information is classified, so this is about all I can tell you for now, but... it must have been tough for you to travel from Ludibrium to here. Take this, the #b#t2030012##k.

yes.0: The #b#t2030012##k I gave you will enable you to teleport straight to Ludibrium. Please be aware that you may not use this on other continents. Thank you so much for helping me out on numerous occasions. Now that I have the parts ready, I better get this started.

npc.0: Please take these 3 Boxes of Parts and give them to #b#p2050001##k of the Omega Sector. I'm sure he's been sticking his neck out for this. These machines are all very delicate, so please be careful on your way there. I'll see you around~!

item.0: Hmmm... I think you have met #b#p2040003##k, but you may have lost one of the boxes full of robotic parts on your way back here. I need 3 Boxes of Parts, and without one, it's nothing. Please go see #p2040003# again at the Ludibrium Toy Factory, receive all 3 boxes full of robotic parts, and then deliver them to me. Thanks!

lost.0: Hmmm... did you lose the Boxes of Parts on your way back? Should have been more careful... but thankfully, the Boxes of Parts have the automatic-returning device created by #b#p2050001##k, so they are back here already. I'll give them to you once more, so please don't lose it this time!

0.0: Ohhh... good thing you're here. I've been really needing your help, and thank goodness you're here. It's about the Boxes of Parts that you brought here last time... are you willing to listen?

yes.0: Thank you for making some time with me. I have heard that someone's been looking for the boxes, but I didn't think much of it, until one day, the Boxes of Parts disappeared totally. The Boxes of Parts have been stolen, and I think it's the work of the aliens. Maybe they were just worried about the possibility of our new robot controlling their livelihood.
yes.1: The one good thing is that, thanks to the automatic-returning device I attached to all the boxes, even the most intricate of the responses will generate a signal that'll enable us to locate where the boxes are located at. They may have broken the device, but I don't think they completely destroyed it. The Boxes of Parts are hidden at the Boswell Field. Go there, and you may find a box that looks like that of the aliens. Your task is to destroy that box and bring back the Box of Parts.

no.0: Hmmm ... you must be busy doing things here and there, but this is a very important task, and we don't have much time. I can't think of anyone else worthy of taking on this task but you! Please, if you ever change your mind, talk to me, okay?

1.0: Hoh... you brought all 3 Boxes of Parts! I'm sure the... 3aliens made your way back a little more difficult that it should have been... you really must be something special. How about joining us and working here full-time as a member of the Omega Sector? Hahaha... anyway, great job there. Since you worked so hard to make it here, I'll give you some more spare Warp Capsules. Please take this.

yes.0: Now that all the parts are here, I'll have to get back to work. Oh, before I do that... I better make sure to attach these Boxes of Parts with the newest automatic-returning device! It would be terrible to have these stolen by the aliens, again. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have a lot of work to do... I'll see you around~

item.0: Hmmm... I don't think you have all 3 Boxes, yet. Head over to a secretive place around Boswell Field, all the way to the alien headquarters, and you'll find a huge box that appears to be that of the aliens'. Your task is to break those Boxes, and find the 3 Boxes of Parts for me. I'll be here waiting for you!

QuestInfo.0: I should go see Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.
QuestInfo.1: Dr. Kim of the Command Center notified me that a powerful new Alien has appeared somewhere around the Boswell Field, and wanted me to eliminate it for them. He said he had to ask me for help since the new robot isn't ready just yet... I need to head over to the hidden place at the Boswell Field and defeat at least 5 #bMT-09#k's.\n\n#o5120100# #r#a34081#
QuestInfo.2: I managed to eliminate all 5 MT-09's that Dr. Kim of the Command Center requested. I really hope that the new robot is made soon, so I don't have to ever do this again.

0.0: Hmmm... we have ourselves an emergency. We received a word that a group of imposing, threatening aliens are on their way here. The problem is, the new robot is still on its developmental stage... arrght, this is driving me crazy! You... if  that's fine with you, will you please help us out? We need your word right now.

yes.0: Thank you so much! The word is, there's a group of Mateon aliens on their way here, and one of the most powerful Mateons around, #b#o5120100##k, is already undercover, waiting around the Boswell Field. #b#o5120100##k is definitely unlike anyone else you've ever faced, and even our army is having a difficult time handling it. I guess it's too powerful a monster for even a disciplined army like ours.
yes.1: What I'm asking from you is simple. Please go and defeat 5 #b#o5120100#s#k, which is operated by the aliens. #b#o5120100##k is the culmination of advanced technology from the aliens, so they are much more devastating than anything you've ever run into. I strongly suggest that you take them on with a party, not just by yourself. I'll be waiting for you here. Good luck!

no.0: Really...! I thought you'd be there to help us out. This is quite disappointing. I'll have to find someone else eager to join forces with us. Now, if you'll excuse me...

1.0: Oh my goodness... did you really find a way to defeat #b5 #o5120100#s#k? I knew you were something else, but this just blows my mind!! Alright... since you helped us protect the Omega Sector as well as Ludibrium, I'll have to reward you accordingly. This will definitely help you on your journey, so please take it.

yes.0: What do you think about #b#t1032011##k? I can't even begin to thank you for all your hard work done for the Omega Sector and myself. I am sincerely thankful to have run into someone like you in times of need. Now, it's my job to fully develop the new robot so I don't put all your work in vain. Please drop by to say hello every now and then, alright? Bye!!

mob.0: I don't think you have completed my task, yet. Head over to the hidden area of Boswell Field defeat #b5 #o5120100#s#k for us.

QuestInfo.0: I should go see Chury of Omega Sector.
QuestInfo.1: I met with Chury at the Silo of the Omega Sector again, and he requested that I find a secret base of an apparent alien-worshipper. I'll need to find Dogon's HQ, which is hidden somewhere around the Fields nearby Omega Sector, find #bDogon's Report#k from the box at the Dogon's HQ, and give them to Chury.
QuestInfo.2: I gave Chury, who was waiting for me at the Silo of the Omega Sector, the #bDogon's Report#k that I found from Dogon's secret base. I can't believe someone is actually helping aliens... now THAT's quite shocking.

0.0: Hmmm... this is troubling. It seems like there is a group of people that chose to ignore the danger that lies with the aliens, and instead have begun to SUPPORT them. If this is true, then we're in deep trouble, and I'll really need help from someone like you. Will you help us out one more time?

yes.0: Thank you so much. Like I previously mentioned, a few alien supporters have built #bDogon's HQ#k at a hidden area around Omega Sector, and have been providing classified information to the aliens. I knew the aliens have been becoming more powerful by day, but this...
yes.1: The acts like this takes away the liberty and freedom of the innocent people living in this world. We need to find their hidden base and find an item that can be used as an evidence. I'm sure there's a #breport#k that's being sent to the aliens by the alien-supporters. I'll be here waiting for you! Good luck!

no.0: You must be really busy right now, but this is unlike any other emergency we've experienced, and we really need help from someone like you. If you ever want to change your mind, please talk to me.

1.0: Oh... you must have really found #bDogon's HQ#k. I was hoping such would be nothing more than rumors... I guess not. We really have a group of alien-supporters that provide information beneficial to aliens. This is very troubling... anyway, since you found their base, as well as bringing the #breport#k here with you, I can't express enough thanks for your hard work. As a reward, here's some money, as well as a pair of earrings.

yes.0: Thank you so much for your help. All we have to do now is to examine the #b#t4031107##k that you brought here. I wonder what's inside... anyway, I'll have to get back to work now, so if you'll excuse me... I'll see you around!

0.0: Hello there, my child. What can I do for you?
0.1: A spring of youth, you say? Why yes, there is no reason for me to deny its existence. It is very much a real thing, but you can not simply drink from it using any cup or mug. People foolishly try, using the wrong tools, and they end up turning old and weak instead.
0.2: But you would like to know where the correct chalice for the Spring of Youth can be found? Well, I can make it for you. In fact, all fairies regularly drink from the springs of Ellinia trees… It is how we manage to live for so long! But, where was I? Oh yes, the chalice. Bring me 5 Sap of Ancient Tree, 40 Medicine With Weird Vibes, 40 Malady's Experimental Frog, 40 Squishy Liquid, 1 Nependeath Honey, and I will make the chalice for you! But beware, the water of Ellinian trees is very potent, and overconsumption does more harm than good!

yes.0: Excellent. Report back to me when you have the items I asked for.

no.0: Very well. It's your choice! I'm not making the chalice for free, so come back to me when you are interested in putting in the work.

1.0: You brought the items! That was certainly quick work! Very well, I will forge and enchant the chalice right now…
1.1: And here it is! One enchanted chalice, made according to ancient Fairy tradition! But remember what I said, do not drink too much or too quickly! It may be the last thing you do! And, if you need directions, these Springs of Youth are typically located very high up in the trees. Try to climb as high as you can, and see if you can find one!

item.0: My child, you did not bring all of the items that I asked for. Now go, and don't bother me unless you have them all!

QuestInfo.0: Mar the Fairy has the ability to create chalices capable of scooping water from the Spring of Youth… Maybe I can speak to her once more…

0.0: Okay, now take these to the top of the Black Mountain. At the very top, you'll see an abandoned house with 3 King Goblins from the storybook hidden inside. It'll be near impossible to find them just by looking at them, you know; Goblins are very good at hiding from human sight. I'll ask you this one more time: Are you sure you can handle this? This is not going to be easy.

yes.0: Very trustworthy. Hahaha... Okay, now I'll teach you how to draw those Goblins out. The #bYellow King Goblin#k is a Goblin that gets easily frightened like a chicken. It's the Goblin that once was so scared by the cracking sound of a hazelnut bite that it ran without picking up its own bat. Now, this Goblin is a big fan of pork, so if you head over to the abandoned house and place roasted pork on a stack of rocks near the house, it'll show up for sure.
yes.1: Next up is the #bBlue King Goblin#k, who is prone to forgetting things here and there. This Goblin manages to lose things quite frequently, once even losing the Goblin Hat. Some petty thief picked it up and tried stealing other things, until he got caught by the people and got heavily punished for it. This Goblin prefers #bRice Wine#k. There's a #bStone Lantern#k around the abandoned house; pour the Rice Wine in it, and it'll surely come out of the house.
yes.2: Last, but not least, the #bGreen King Goblin#k likes to engage in some Korean Wrestling. There are times in the middle of the night where it'd pop out in front of an unsuspecting soul in the middle of the night, and engage in Korean Wrestling, wearing the person out in the process. This Goblin is very fond of #bbuckwheat paste#k, and if you place it inside the #btree hole#k at a tree near the abandoned house, it'll surely appear.
yes.3: Your task is to defeat all 3 King Goblins and bring back the items that they'll drop: Goblin bat, Goblin hat, and the Goblin cape. This may be too hard for you to handle alone, so I suggest you team up with a couple of your friends.

no.0: Yes, it's a tough task, and I totally understand if you're not ready for it. Once you gain the confidence to beat the Goblins, bring back the 3 baits and talk to me.

QuestInfo.0: #bTae Soo#k, the kid in charge of protecting the Peach Farm of Mu Lung, apparently experienced something very strange...
QuestInfo.1: While aimlessly walking around Sky Forest, Tae Soo was ambushed by a terrifying wild bear. Of course, every once in a while, you'll run into a few that will act up on their instincts and attack humans. I ran into a bear like that a while ago at the Sky Forest.
0.1: I was stunned when I was attacked, because Sky Forest is normally a peaceful place. Its long, sharp claws were ferociously swung literally inches from my eyes. Then, something incredible happened. A powerful force fired by someone took out the wild bear and rescued me, but...
0.2: The one that helped me wasn't a human, either. He actually looked even more ferocious than the wild bear... he was #ba Hulking Bear with a Scar on His Eye#k. I found myself controlled by fear once again. He looked like he was going to use me as his lunch pale, but... he just turned around and left... without saying a word... without acknowledging my 'thank you'.
0.3: I feel terrible that he may have felt offended by my response, even though I was more than grateful for his help. His attire suggests that he may be one of the bears training to become the Master at Sky Forest... who must that be? If it's okay with you, can you do me a huge favor and find out what he's all about?

yes.0: Ahh... thank you. From looking at his uniform, he may be one of the students of #bNo Gong#k. Pretty much everyone around here that's involved in physical training is a student of No Gong, so... that's my guess. Please go see No Gong and ask about him. Thanks!

1.0: Hmmm? What is it? Are you interested in physical training? Whaatt? You saw a bear outside and did what? It's really hard to tell since there are so many bears around here... They all are my students, but... they all look alike. No?

0.11: Zipangu... will be destroyed a 100 years from now.
0.12: ...Yes, Zipangu will one day completely disappear from this world without a trace. I saw it with my own eyes how this ball of #bdistortion#k appeared from the sky and completely swallowed up Zipangu as a whole.
0.13: Zipangu in the ancient days was a hotbed for black magic, and I am a magician in Zipangu who grew up learning the intricacies of the black magic.
0.14: At the time, Zipangu had strong ties with Magatia, sharing valuable informations with one another. You may be living in an age where science rules the world, but back in the day, Magatia was home to various studies regarding the black magic.
0.15: Magatia, the forefront of magic powers.\nThat's where I met a wizard, who taught me everything and... in the end... I was able to acquire a special power that allowed me to achieve #bimmortality#k.
0.16: It was the magic that no one could achieve until then. I used it wisely for the sake of Zipangu.\n As time went on, however, new generations came and went, and immortality became an outlawed practice. All of a sudden, I was considered an outcast, embraced by no one. I lost everything; fame, fortune, country, you name it, I lost it. In the end, I went into seclusion in the mountains of Zipangu, eager to use my power of immortality to view the apocalypse, the day the world ends for good.
0.17: But the apocalypse... came much, much sooner than I anticipated.
0.18: The moment Zipangu got swallowed up by a giant \n#bdistortion#k and vanished, I used a time-warp magic to enter the world after the vanishment. And that's where I found it.
0.19: That's where I found the truth of Zipangu.
0.20: It turned out that the history of Zipangu is chronicled in a single book.
0.21: The history of Zipangu was just a reenactment of the contents listed in the book.
0.22: The fact that a supernatural book that chronicles every move of every resident of Zipangu exists... the book that's called #bAcacia Chronicle#k...
0.23: I don't know about you, but I was furious. Furious at the thought of my life being pre-determined by this miniscule copy of a book...
0.24: In that world of distortion, I was able to get my hands on \n#bAcacia Chronicle#k, and started reading it.
0.26: I realized that #bAcacia Chronicle#k did not include informations about me.
0.27: I was someone that did not exist, according to the book.
0.28: It might be that the reason why I was freed from the #bcurse of Acacia Chronicle#k was because I was able to form a close bond with someone outside Zipangu, which in the end led me to achieve #bimmortality#k.
0.29: It also remained to be seen whether #bAcacia Chronicle#k can be subject to change in contents for revised editions.
0.30: So my plan was to return to the past and alter the history myself, so the part where the #bdistortion#k appeared in the book would be destroyed at the last minute, and prevent Zipangu from a certain destruction.
0.31: But in the end, I realized that tampering with the past, even if it meant saving Zipangu, would be a foolish act.\nAltering the past through the book would most certainly wipe out the very existence of all those people that would be born in the future.
0.32: In the end, I came to conclusion that the best course of action would be to alter the history of Zipangu RIGHT BEFORE the destruction.
0.33: The problem is that altering the history is not a one-time deal. History has its ability to revise itself, so even if I alter a portion of it, the history would try to remedy that by returning to its pre-alteration stage.
0.34: Today, I spend my days observing Zipangu which is right on the verge of destruction, with the starting point being #m802000101#.
0.36: I see a huge wave of history revision coming soon, and it's such that even I can't do anything about it.
0.37: I am fully aware that since this is all about Zipangu, it's only right that a resident of Zipangu should take care of this in-house.
0.38: Unfortunately, #bThe Spell of Acacia#k has prevented Zipanguans from directly altering the history themselves.

Dunas, who mastered the magic of past life
Ashray, who mastered the magic of time warp;
and myself, the one that mastered the magic of immortality.

0.7: Only Ashray was going to die and disappear, eventually.
0.8: #o9400270# and Ashray were madly in love.\nThere's no way to tell what she saw in the future with her power to time warp, but I'm sure it was a future she didn't envision having.\nHaving encountered an inconquerable wall called immortality, she was distraught and started to curse her unique powers.
0.9: And...\nshe wanted my magic of immortality.

0.11: She disappeared from that era soon after.

0.13: My magical powers became outdated to that of generations past, so I had a really difficult time facing these robots in front of me. The destruction of Tokyo was well on the way, and I did not resemble anything that of what I was; a protector of Zipangu.
0.15: I finally found Ashray. She was...

0.17: I found her, damaged shoulders and all, still casting spells to battle against the army of robots. I immediately came to her defense.
0.18: That's when Ashray finally told me. The army of robots summoned a high dose of concentrated energy from this dimension, and she saw it in the future that it would trigger the end of Zipangu.
0.19: The reason she requested my powers of immortality was so that she could save Zipangu.
0.20: I wept openly in front of her. The thousands of years I spent being bitter towards her melted away immediately. I felt so ashamed. All this time, I assumed she wanted that power so she could be with #o9400270#. All this time, I thought she was just being selfish.
0.21: She pulled out all stops trying to prevent the destruction of Zipangu, but in the end came to one conclusion.
0.22: In order to prevent the destruction, a magician must insert one's self with a high dose of concentrated energy, and prevent the destruction from taking place. 0.23: I kept asking Ashray why she didn't tell me all this, since I was ready to do anything for Zipangu.
0.24: Her answer was that "I couldn't trust your power of magic."\n\nShe then flashed a smile.
0.26: I agreed to her deal and gave her my power of immortality. She exchanged it for her power of time warp. Because we merely exchanged our special powers, we didn't upset the balance that our master stressed.
0.27: Then, once that #bhigh dose of concentrated energy#k appeared, she tried to wholly absorb it, to no avail. This ball of energy was much, much more powerful than anything we ever imagined...
0.28: This uncontrollable ball of energy then swallowed up Zipangu as a whole, and the place disappeared without a trace.
0.29: After the destruction, Ashray and I were wandering all over the world when we discovered the existence of #bAcacia Chronicle#k. She then gave me the final strategy.
0.31: Her plan was to use the power of time-warp to rewrite history. \nIt was a last resort, indeed.
0.32: Re-writing history.\nFor her, this would mean nothing more than to trap her in a world of unknown.
0.33: I disagreed with her on this, but she was indeed a protector of Zipangu until the very end.
0.34: I couldn't say no to her undying will to save Zipangu, so I used the magic of time-warp to return to the past.
0.35: And after much studying, I was also able to acquire the power to control time. This was an extension of the research that Ashray initiated, one that she worked on because I was unwilling to give her the power of immortality.
0.36: This gave me an ability to freeze the time flow of a designated area. I was able to freeze time for #b#m802000101##k, and was able to acquire an immortality of sort here, since the time stopped.
0.37: This was all done to prevent the destruction of Zipangu.\nI began the effort to rewrite history, beginning with #b#m802000101##k.

yes.0: Soon, I was able to figure out what #o9400270# was about, he of the magic of past life.

yes.3: I respected Ashray's wishes.

yes.13: I have sealed up his spirit at a far corner of #b#m802000101##k.
yes.14: Yes, his spirit is still here. (#p9120025# then looks around, as if in search of something.)

yes.17: (The grounds of #b#m802000101##k begins to shake violently)

QuestInfo.0: There's a Masked Man in New Leaf City... what's his deal?
QuestInfo.1: I spoke with Jack Masque, he's a bandit prince from Amoria. He's in love with Princess Restless, and is trying to win her love from afar. He's got a passionate hatred for Wolf Spiders, as one bit her just as she was giving him a kiss. So, I've agreed to hunt down 100 Wolf Spiders in return for his thanks and something special he picked up. I should be able to find them in the MesoGears...
QuestInfo.2: +Phew* I wiped out 100 of those pesky Wolf Spiders, and in return, I received a Leaf Crystal from Jack Masque. I can come back every 72 hours to help him if I want. I wonder what he did to get kicked out of Amoria...?
QuestInfo.name: Urban Jungle

0.0: Hello there. Do you have a moment to spare?

yes.0: Wonderful. Name's Jack. Jack Masque. I'm from Amoria, but that neither here nor there...it's a long story why I left...but since you're still here, I'll give you the short version. I'm in love! I am lost in the throes of passion with the most beautiful creature I have laid eyes upon...a Princess. Princess Restless to be exact. I'm competing for her with some snob-nosed prince. We were out on our first date, and the time was perfect. The sun was shining, birds were tweeting, and just as I was about to receive a kiss from her sweet lips, this strange spider attacked us! I fought the beast off, but that was a one in a million chance with her! I swore to wear this mask in shame until I could return to Amoria with honor. But I must hurry, that accursed Prince Vince is sure to attempt to steal her away...So, I want you to go and eliminate 100 Wolf Spiders, which should ensure that this never happens again. If you're successful, I have a particularly rare crystal that may suit you...get going!

no.0: Unfortunate. Be on your way then!

1.0: Fantastic! I'll be able to face her again without worrying if one of those pesky Wolf Spiders will spoil the moment. As promised, here is your reward. Enjoy! And in three days time, you may return to me for another hunt! \n\n#L0##bActually, can you tell me more about yourself?#k#l
1.1: Anything else you wish to know? \n\n#L0##bWhy is that mask really on your face?#k#l
1.2: I'm a prideful man, and the thought that I lost my chance due to spider is...rather embarrassing to be honest. Icebyrd offered me a chance to redeem myself, and I took it. I won't take off this mask until I can return to Amoria with honor! You've helped me and I never forget a favor. I may have a few tasks for you in the future. With your help, I'm sure that I'd get a leg up on that walking waste of space known as Prince Vince... Does this answer your question?

yes.0: As promised, here is your reward. Enjoy! And in three days time, you may return to me for another hunt!

mob.0: Tsk, tsk. So sad. I said #b100 Wolf Spiders#k. Not 74, not 32, not 99. 100. Come back when you have something to show for your effort-besides a tired face.

QuestInfo.1: I spoke with the famous John Barricades' one-half of the world famous Barricade Bros. Treasure Hunting Co. He spoke to me about Subani, the legendary mage responsible for the Dark Scrolls throughout the Maple World. He believes there is something within the MesoGears that may be a treasure of his. I've agreed to help clear the way. I'll have to defeat #b50 Killa Bees, 30 Mighty Maple Eaters and 40 Fire Tusks#k so I can explore deeper into the MesoGears...
QuestInfo.2: I cleared a path straight through the MesoGears, and now I can explore there in peace. When I'm ready, I can see John Barricade to continue with the next part of this adventure!
QuestInfo.name: Subani's Legacy - Discovery

0.0: Hey. Got a sec?

yes.0: Then you've come to the right place! Name's John Barricade, one half of the world-famous Barricade Bros. Treasure Hunting Co. I've been trying to explore the Temple Hive, but I haven't got that far in. But with your help, I think we can make a push to discover some treasure...First, I'll need you to clear the area. Wipe out #b50 Killa Bees, 30 Mighty Maple Eaters#k and #b40 Fire Tusks#k. After that, head back to me and we'll get some real work done. Hop to it, kid!

All my other subjects were ok, but I always got straight A's in History-probably because my dad would kick my butt if I didn't. That what happens when you grow up with an archeologist for a father. \n\n#L0##bWhat about your family?#k#l

1.3: Oh, sorry. It happens sometimes. After college, my brother and I concluded that the only way to live forever was to find the Fountain of Youth. It took 3 years, but we finally found it! \n\n#L0##bNO WAY!#k#l
1.4: WAY! \n\n#L0##bThat's awesome!#k#l
1.5: We thought so too, but man we made a lot of businesses mad with that one...

yes.0: Ok, let's get going. Clear a path, come on back and let's figure out this mystery.

QuestInfo.1: I spoke with John, and he's found a set of weird markings in the MesoGears that he can't decipher. He's mentioned that he'll need special crystals known as #bHyper Glyphs#k. I've agreed to snag #b50#k of them so he can decipher the markings. Electrophants...John thinks that the mechanism on their heads may have those Hyper Glyphs inside. I'd better be careful-I don't want to get shocked!
QuestInfo.2: I got the #b50 Hyper Glyphs#k that John needed, and he's hard at work deciphering the markings. I should come back soon to see if he's finished!
QuestInfo.name: Subani's Legacy - Transgression

0.0: Back already, huh? Well, you proved your worth, so I'll tell you a little story...

yes.0: Well, if you've heard of Dark Scrolls, you've heard about Subani. He was the powerful magician who sacrificed himself to seal away the evil demon, Naricain. The scrolls are all over the place, but that's not what we're here for. I got a tip from this funny looking guy over in Purplewood Forest, went by the name of Glimmer Man. He mentioned that Subani had a horde of items stashed away, and that the MesoGears would be a good place to look. I did some digging, thanks to the path you cleared, and found some strange markings. I don't know what they say, but I do know that there only one thing that deciphers marking like these-a #bHyper Glyph#k. It can decipher other languages, but the problem is, you can only use it once, and there are 50 markings. I'll need you to hunt down #b50 Hyper Glyphs#k so we can keep going-I know we're close to something...Try those weird-looking elephants that shoot electricity. I'm willing to bet they're hiding something in that mechanism on top of their heads!

no.0: Well, ok. You never turn down a good legend though, they always turn out to be true...

1.0: Nice work! Now, I'll need some time to study these markings.\n\n#L0##bTell me some more about your discoveries.#k#l
1.1: Heh, ok. You asked for a list, well, my bro and I have discovered King Solomon's Mines, solved the mystery of Stonehenge, found Captain Kidd's gold horde, unearthed the trove of the Knights Templar, the Lost Dutchman's Gold Mine, the Sphinx Chamber, and countless Spanish galleons. Not bad for a few years! \n\n#L0##bHoly crap! What do you think we'll find here?#k#l
1.2: I have a hunch that Subani left something here. I remember when I explored the Sphinx Chamber, I discovered an old legend that was eerily similar to that of Subani and Naricain. It also foretells that the act that created the Dark Scrolls was not their final battle. I'm not sure what we'll find, but I'm sure it pertains to that. It also mentioned another world... \n\n#L0##bAnother world? Elpam's outside, have you spoken with him?#k#l
1.3: Not yet, he smells a bit too much like old cheese... but if he really is from where he said, I might have to...

yes.0: Ok, kid, get going! Return to me soon, and I should have more information!

item.0: Looking good, kid-but I'll need #b50 Hyper Glyphs#k to read the markings. I'll be waiting!

QuestInfo.0: John has finished deciphering the markings! I need to get back to the Temple Hive now!
QuestInfo.1: John and I spoke again, and something unforeseen happened. I'll have to track down #b50 MesoGears Map Pieces#k so he can put together the map! He mentioned the robots he "borrowed" for some assistance went all crazy, kept saying "#bI.AM.ROBOT#k" as they scurried into the Krakian Jungle...
QuestInfo.2: Finally done! I took the pieces back to John, and he's going to start piecing the map together. However, he did come across a strange ring that passed on to me. If this was the first treasure, I wonder where the rest is...
QuestInfo.name: Subani's Legacy - Deliverance

0.0: Right on time! We've got a problem...

It was like they were being controlled...Anyways, they have the #bMesoGears Map Pieces#k. All of #b50#k of them. I'll need you to hunt them down and bring them back so I can start assembling the map. I'll poke around a bit in the MesoGears and see what I can find...

no.0: ust when you were getting good... I guess it was too good to be true.

yes.0: Might not be the treasure we wanted off the bat, but when I'm done putting this map together, you and I are going hunting, Barricade Bros. style!

QuestInfo.0: There's a mysterious traveler in New Leaf City-he doesn't look like he's from anywhere around here. I should ask him what's going on. It could be interesting...
QuestInfo.1: I spoke with Elpam Gorlab, and he's a traveler from Versal, the mirror-world of MapleStory. Tell me what you know.#k#l

However, their ambition far outstripped their control of the technology, and there was an accident. Masteria, the great land, finally fell into the sea, its secrets lost forever. Until now. I made a deal with someone to raise the continent, and establish the city in the ruins of Olde Sapp Village. He brought my dream to life, and it cost me next to nothing. And that's where we are now. However, the city has many, many secrets that even I don't know about. Tread carefully; you never know what can open up... \n\n#L0##bOk, I know what how it was raised, but who raised it? 0.1:
Why, thank you!  I am called the Glimmer Man...and yes, there are few like me in this world.  I am a mage of some power, a traveler of land and space, and a scholar of the universe and its many mysteries.

#b#L0#That's quite a funky jacket you have on.#l
#L1#Yeah, whatever... freak.  Powerful mage?  A space clown is more like it!#l#k
0.2: Stylish, isn't it?  I made this jacket myself.  Might look a little weird, but the purple markings are actually enchantments. They make this particular coat highly resistant to magic. Not that I really need it anymore anyway... \r\n\r\n#b#L0#Why is that?#l
0.3: Do you see my skin?  I am called the Glimmer Man because I can turn my body into pure diamond with a mere thought.  No, it was not something I was born with...it was a skill I learned.  My diamond form renders me impervious to magic, as well as having quite a number of other handy effects.  In this form, I've been able to survive in outer space and journey through the cosmos.  I have seen and learned much in my travels...much that most men and women have never seen, nor will ever see. \r\n\r\n#b#L0#Why are you here? Surely a mage of your power has better things to do...#l
0.4:
After leaving the realm of Ellinia where I began my training, and having exhausted my avenues of learning at an early age, I traveled the distant reaches of space for many years in search of new things, new ways to improve on my abilities as a magician.  Other than a few not-so-amicable run-ins with the Grays, it turns out that space is...well, mostly made of space.
Just when I had despaired of finding new frontiers to explore, I heard that Masteria had appeared off of Victoria Island, emerging from the depths of the sea!  The tales of this place had always intrigued me-this land is rumored to be where those come to find their destiny; or in other words, gain greater power.  I had heard legends of the Grandmasters of the fabled Crimsonwood Keep, how they were without peer in their chosen professions.  Exactly the sort of place I'd been looking for to extend my knowledge!  Who knew that that such a place would be on the very planet that I'd left?  And as luck would have it, one of the very things I had searched for in space has been found here!

#b#L0#What are you looking for exactly?#l
0.5: In my pursuit of power, I have become a weapons crafter by trade.  I design all kinds... from handheld armaments to star-breakers on battle cruisers.  Years ago, I came across a very rare element called #bWhite Versal Materia#k. I had only a small sample of it but even in that small amount I saw the potential of the material!  It could be used to create weapons of tremendous power!  I studied it extensively, and drew up many schematics for weapon designs.  But alas, I did not have enough of the material to actually construct any of these weapons.  I had thought that it was a material found in outer space, and truth be told, one of the primary reasons why I journeyed into the far reaches of the galaxy was to find more.  But from what I've learned, it's not even from this world!  Rather, it's from an alternate dimension of the Maple World...a world called Versal!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Whoa!#l
0.6: Imagine my amazement upon my arrival in Masteria when I began to hear that adventurers here have been finding it!  I've already devised blueprints for a new line of hand-held weapons using this rare element!  The designs are exquisite...but unproven.  If I only had some White Versal Materia!  Should you find any, please return it to me!  In exchange for allowing me to try out and perfect my designs, you can keep the weapon I create.  Deal?

Children from all over Maple World used to come here to see his creations and beg their parents to buy them-- and Jonas would hold lavish parties every holiday for them. yes.0: Thank you.  Thank you so much.\r\nForgive my rough words earlier.  My name is Thomlin Prendergast.  Jonas was my older brother.  The story I told you before was true... I was there.  After Sophilia's accident, Jonas went mad.  He locked himself in his workshop, refusing to see anyone, ignoring our pleas through the door to take food and water.  Even the constant thrum of the Prendergast Toy Machine that once permeated the house fell silent as Jonas mourned.
yes.1: One day, the noises of the Toy Machine started up again!  We rushed up to the Workshop door, hoping that Jonas had come out.  But the door remained locked, and the noises coming from within... these were not the same noises as before!  It was a terrible screeching, like the grinding of gears, fearsome thumping noises, and god knows what else!
yes.2: To make matters worse, many of the household staff swore to have seen the ghost of Sophilia... and they began to desert the house.  I confess... I saw her myself.  Soon, everyone had left.  The only ones who remained behind were myself, Edmunds, our loyal butler, and Jonas' wife, Ludmilla, who could not bear to leave the life she had to which she had grown accustomed.
yes.3: I had an extra key to Jonas' Workshop, and Edmunds begged me to go in and talk to my brother.  With great fear and trepidation, I ascended to the top of the house, climbing to the heights of my brother's workspace.
yes.4: There, I found Jonas... dead at the controls of his Toy Machine.  He had been dead for awhile.  There were toys everywhere.
yes.5: Standing there, in front of my brother's lifeless body, his huge mechanical contraption looming above me... I couldn't help but feel that somehow part of Jonas' spirit, his grief, had entered his Toy Machine.  As if it had heard my thoughts, the machine began to crank out toys... monstrous toys I had never seen before!  They were my brother's toys... but twisted, hateful.  In my haste and fright, I dropped my key as I fled the house.   I... I have never gone back in since.
yes.6: ... I realize now what my mission is. Please talk to me in a minute.

She was the daughter any father would be proud of. Smart, pretty, lovable... whenever she walked in the room, it was like a ray of sunshine.  She was spirited, adventuresome, mischievous.  The entire household loved her, it was a joy to see her playing about the house, always embarking on some adventure of her own design.  Her smile alone could brighten anyone's day!
Sophilia loved playing with everything - jewelry, dolls, rocking horses, she'd get her hands on everything she could, that little girl!  Her father was often busy with his work, and her stepmother despised her, so she was often left alone to her own devices.  This house is far from town, and rather than real friends, Sophilia had to make do with her father's toys, and her own imagination.  We played with her when we could, but we were often busy with work, and tending to Master Prendergast's business and Ludmilla's needs.  A few weeks ago, we realized that none of us had seen Sophilia in awhile.
Then one day, a few days thereafter, I... I found her.  No one knew what happened exactly, but it looked like she'd somehow taken to exploring the inside of the house, and had taken a fall while climbing the Chimney.  Of all places for a young child to be!  What on earth could have possessed her to do such a thing?
But I... I blame myself.  I should've watched her a bit closer.  In fact, now that I think of it, the last few times I saw that sweet girl alive, she kept asking me if I had seen her doll.  I was busy and thought nothing of it as her father had made her so many to play with.  <Sob>  I'm sorry; it pains me to think that a life so dear and sweet could be so easily extinguished.
0.1: No one took Sophilia's death harder than Master Prendergast.  He withdrew from Ludmilla, the household, from life.  For weeks he was beside himself with grief, refusing to eat.  He even shut down his Toy Machine and stopped all production on his toys.  A few days ago, he locked himself up in his Toy Workshop at the top of this house, and the noises of his Toy Machine began again.  He began making toys again. <shudders> But, these toys sound nothing like the toys he used to make before.  Can't you hear them?  I fear that his beloved daughter's death may have driven Master Prendergast past his senses.  I am afraid for him, but I am also afraid to go up to the Workshop now because of the noises.\r\nYou look brave.  If you could, please check on him for me, will you?
