0.0: She was the daughter any father would be proud of. Smart, pretty, lovable...whenever she walked in the room, it was like a ray of sunshine.  She was spirited, adventuresome, mischievous.  The entire household loved her, it was a joy to see her playing about the house, always embarking on some adventure of her own design.  Her smile alone could brighten anyone's day!\r\nSophilia loved playing with everything-jewelry, dolls, rocking horses, she'd get her hands of everything she could, that little girl!  Her father was often busy with his work, and her stepmother despised her, so she was often left alone to her own devices.  This house is far from town, and rather than real friends, Sophilia had to make do with her father's toys, and her own imagination.  We played with her when we could, but we were often busy with work, and tending to Master Prendergast's business and Ludmilla's needs. A few weeks ago, we realized that none of us had seen Sophilia in awhile.\r\nThen one day, a few days thereafter, I... I found her.  No one knew what happened exactly, but it looked like she'd somehow taken to exploring the inside of the house, and had taken a fall.  I... I blame myself.  I should've watched her a bit closer.  <Sob>  I'm sorry; it pains me to think that a life so dear and sweet could be so easily extinguished.
0.1: No one took Sophilia's death harder than Master Prendergast.  He withdrew from Ludmilla, the household, from life.  For weeks he was beside himself with grief, refusing to eat.  He even shut down his Toy Machine and stopped all production on his toys.  A few days ago, he locked himself up in his Toy Workshop at the top of this house, and the noises of his Toy Machine began again.  He began making toys again. <shudders> But, these toys sound nothing like the toys he used to make before.  Can't you hear them?  I fear that his beloved daughter's death may have driven Master Prendergast past his senses.  I am afraid for him, but I am also afraid to go up to the Workshop now because of the noises.\r\nYou look brave.  If you could, please check on him for me, will you?  Master Prendergast's Workshop is located near the top of the house.  It's only accessible through one wing of the house, which is only reachable through the doors at the top of the Library.  I'd be wary-it's a dangerous place, with open machinery.  Please... see how he is.  We are all quite worried about him.
0.2:
I am not alone in that, my young friend.  Ludmilla, is, shall we say, difficult.  I have been a professional manservant for decades, but she tries even my patience. <trembles with rage>
The woman orders me around all day, and does nothing but eat, shop, and lay about.  It's like being subject to the whim of a spoiled dog.  However, even that is within my duties... but there are other reasons for my feelings.
When I said that Sophilia could brighten anyone's day, I meant anyone except for Ludmilla, that is.  I believe she was jealous of Master Prendergast's affection for her.  She usually ignored young mistress Sophilia but all of us could sense the resentment she bore her.
But enough, I shall remain the professional, and speak no more on this.

<Sigh> All this paranormal investigating just hasn't been too fun for me.  However, I figured that while I'm stuck out here on this mission... the least I could do was to cook up a big batch of my famous Smores to take back to the office for my colleagues!  Have you tasted them?  Back at headquarters, I'm actually quite famous for them!  You see, my superiors were already upset with me from my previous mission... So I figured that bringing back some of my delicious Smores upon my return might get me back in their good graces!  So, this whole time I've been camped out here, I've been busy... busy making Smores!
But then... disaster struck!

#b#L0#And by disaster, were you referring to yourself?  Maybe you should consider a different career... like #ecooking#n.
#k#l#b#L1#<Sigh> What happened now, Falcon?#k#l

I turned my back for one second and when I looked back, there was this pale, black-haired kid standing on the Mansion steps, staring at me.  Creepy little guy... <shivers> Gave me the willies the way he looking at me!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#I think I know who you are talking about. What did he do to you?#k#l

I tried to chase him but he was in that door in a flash.  My eyes might have been playing tricks on me but he moved faster than any little kid I'd ever seen before! \r\n\r\n#b#L0#Really? I'll pay you for each Smore you bring back to me!  Please, will you help me recover my treats?

QuestInfo.0: There's a little girl with a puzzled look on her face in New Leaf City.  With X-mas time just around the corner, she should be happy... I wonder why she looks so puzzled and confused instead?  Looks like she may need some help with her Maplemas spirit!
QuestInfo.1: Little Suzy was all excited for Maplemas this year... until she learned all about a similar holiday called "Versalmas" from a strange green mouse named O-Pongo.  Now she doesn't know what sounds more exciting - Maplemas... or Versalmas?  Suzy needs my help to help her decide which version of X-mas she should celebrate this year.  In order to do that, I'll have to speak to both Maple Claws and this O-Pongo character, and then come back and talk to her.  Maplemas holiday from an alternate dimension, huh?  Very curious...
QuestInfo.2: I spoke to both Maple Claws and O-Pongo.  It seems that both Maplemas and Versalmas have their merits.  In the end, Suzy's put the decision on me: she's asked me to deliver her X-mas Wishlist to one of the two "Santas," which will determine which holiday she's celebrating this year.  I have a feeling that this decision is important, that I'm not just making a choice for her... but also one for myself.  Which holiday do I believe in?
QuestInfo.name: Little Suzy's X-Mas Dilemma

0.0:
Ok!  My question is: what's better...  Maplemas or Versalmas?

#b#L0#Versalmas?!  What are you talking about, little girl?  There's no such thing as Versalmas!#l#k
#b#L1#Listen, little girl, I've got more important things to do than answer stupid kid questions.#l
0.1: I'm not little!  I'm 10 years old!  And there is too such a thing as Versalmas!  O-Pongo told me all about it!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#O-Pongo?  Um, right... I suppose this "O-Pongo" is your invisible "friend."#l
0.2: No, silly! O-Pongo is real! In fact, he's right in Happyville this year...go look if you don't believe me!  He's just like Maple Claws except he's big and green and a mouse and wears purple instead of red!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Ok...#l
0.3: Well, maybe he's not exactly alike, but he's the Maple Claws from his world -- the world of Versal!  O-Pongo told me all about it!  He told me about how it's usually dark but that the sun shines day after day after Versalmas comes and how all the kids dance and sing together and get special treats and candies!  It sounds very exciting--more exciting than Maplemas!  Well, maybe not more-- I do like all the presents I get from my parents on Maplemas.  But you get presents for Versalmas too!  I was already going to ask Maple Claws for a new pair of skis and other stuff, but I don't know what kind of presents since I've never had Versalmas before... so maybe Versalmas presents are even better!  But Maplemas Trees are so pretty and I love decorating them!  So-- Oh, I don't know!  Both holidays sound so good but I don't know if I'm allowed to celebrate both...\r\n<looks sad>\r\nPlease... can you... can you help me decide?  You're older than I am... you should know!  Pleaaaaase!

yes.0: Yayyyyyyy!  Please, go talk to O-Pongo!  He can tell you all about Versalmas!  And please speak to Maple Claws too... she's in Happyville as usual, of course!  I'm sure you know this already but you can get to Happyville by speaking to #bRupi#k, and she'll take you there.  Then come back and tell me which holiday I should celebrate!  I've been working on my wishlist all year long and I know I'm going to get everything on it because I've been a really good girl!  Please, hurry!  I need to know who's bringing me presents this year!\r\nI can't wait to hear back from you!  Both holidays sound so great!  I can't wait to celebrate, uh--the right holiday!

no.0: I thought being older means you know more but I guess not.  Hmmph!

0.1: This is not a stupid question!  This is very important!  You're a meanie... a stupid meanie with no holiday spirit!

1.0: So, you spoke to both of them?  And what did they say?  Really?  Uh-huh.  And?  Maple Claws said that?  Wow... I love her!  And what about Versalmas?  O-Pongo said that?  Really?!  Wow.  I'm really glad you told me that.  I feel like I know much more about both holidays now!
1.1: Oh...\r\nThis doesn't make my decision any easier at all!\r\nWhat am I going to do?
1.2: I know!  You're older than I am... you know what to do!  Please, take the #bwishlist#k I've made!  You decide for me!  Please give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo!  But please think about this very carefully!  It's an important decision... for both me and you.

yes.0: Thank you very much!  Please let me know who you gave my list to... so I'll know who's bringing me presents this year!

quest.0: So, who's going to be bringing me my presents this year?  You don't know yet?!  Please, I can't stand not knowing!  Please talk to both Maple Claws and O-Pongo and come back!

QuestInfo.0: To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to Maple Claws.  I'm sure she's back in town now in Happyville.
QuestInfo.1: To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to Maple Claws about Suzy's dilemma.  Maple Claws listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy.  I should talk to her in a bit.
QuestInfo.2: Maple Claws gave me a message for Suzy: that as long as she remembers the essence of the Maplemas Spirit, it doesn't really matter what holiday traditions she chooses to follow this year.  I should return to Suzy with Maple Claws' message once I've also spoken to O-Pongo.
QuestInfo.name: The Spirit of Maplemas

0.0:
Merry Maplemas to you, Mapler!  Are you ready to celebrate Maplemas this year?  I hope you've been good...

#b#L0#I've been an excellent kid!#l#k
#b#L1#I've actually been burning ants and stuff!#l
0.1:
Have you?  We'll see once I check my list... <purrs>
<sigh> Hmmm.  But I sense that there's another reason why you've come to see me.

#b#L0#Yes, Maple Claws, a little girl named Suzy asked me to speak with you.#l
0.2: So, Suzy is having a hard time finding her Maplemas spirit this year?  I see.  Sometimes, with the hustle and bustle of everyday life, it's easy for us to forget to treat each other with simple kindnesses.  This is why the holidays are important... it's a time to let us remember the best in us and our fellow Maplers.  But something tells me there's something more to Suzy's dilemma.\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Yes, she spoke to a mouse named O-Pongo who told her about something called Versalmas.  Some sort of alternate Maplemas.#l
0.3: Ah.  I've heard of this O-Pongo.  You say he's a mouse who talks of an alternate version of Maplemas?  Curious.  But it does not surprise me that alternate worlds would celebrate holidays in different ways.\r\nI see that Suzy is excited at the prospect of a different holiday, and likely, different presents.  <purrs in thought>  Very well, will you take her a message from me?

yes.0: Thank you.  It's important that little boys and girls don't forget what it is about the spirit of Maplemas that is important.  Please give me a moment to think about what I should exactly say to her, and then come back to me.

no.0: Part of the Maplemas spirit is spreading the spirit to those who have need of it. I hope you come back when you've found it within you.

0.1: I had a feeling I'd seen a lump of coal with your name on it lying around somewhere in my present storehouse.  Tsk, tsk.

1.0: I've thought of what I need you to tell Suzy.\r\nPlease tell her this: As long as she holds the spirit of kindness and goodwill in her heart all year round, it doesn't matter whether she chooses to celebrate the holidays with a Maplemas Tree, or with Versalmas customs and gifts.  Tell her that as long as she doesn't forget that, Maple Claws will remember her and bring her presents every year.\r\nWill you tell her that?  You will?  Thank you, and a Merry Maplemas to you, too!

QuestInfo.0: To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to O-Pongo.  I'd better speak with this strange green mouse and find out more details about Versalmas.
QuestInfo.1: To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to O-Pongo about Suzy's dilemma.  O-Pongo listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy.  I should talk to her in a bit.
QuestInfo.2: Versal Power! I spoke with O-Pongo, the Versalmas Mouse, who is the "Santa" for the Versal version of Maplemas, and learned a great deal about Versalmas.  He told me about the customs for their holiday--quite different from the Maple World! The world of Versal is usually shrouded in darkness; Versalmas is an annual holiday that celebrates the emergence of the sun in their world, which shines for 90 straight days and only for these 90 days.  For Versalmas, children receive presents every day for the first 30 days, and get cool treats like Sugar-coated Olives and Caramel Onions! Sounds pretty awesome... Now I'd better speak with Maple Claws and head back to Suzy... It makes me wonder for myself though, which holiday would I pick to celebrate?  Hmmm...
QuestInfo.name: A Versal Tradition

0.0: Hoy there, young friend!  My, my, what a beautiful world you live in!  Who am I?  Why, I am O-Pongo!  Nice to meet you!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Nice to meet you too, er, O-Pongo.  So what are you doing here in Happyville?#l#k
0.1: I'm here because it's that time of year!  It's Versalmas time again!  I'm the Versalmas Mouse so I'm here to spread Versalmas cheer!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Versalmas?  What's that?#l#k
0.2: Why, Versalmas is the most wonderful holiday in all of Versal!  How wonderful?  Why, so wonderful that everyone loves Versalmas!  Versalmas is even better than birthdays!  Why, just imagine the best birthday you've ever had... and Versalmas is a hundred times better than that!  It's the most celebrated holiday in Versal!  Well... it's actually the only holiday celebrated in Versal.  But it's still wonderful, nonetheless!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Um, so why are you here?  Shouldn't you be in Versal for that?#l#k
0.3:
As for why I'm here, it's a strange story.  As the Versalmas Mouse, I'm bound by Versalmas law to deliver a present to every Versalian, no matter how far and wide they are located in Versal.  Whew, it's no easy task I tell you!  I had crossed off everyone on my list except for one last name -- Elpam Gorlab!
I had Elpam's gift all ready to go, but I couldn't find him anywhere!  So, I asked my trusty steed, Pwnzer, to "sniff" out where he was, and take me to him, crackity-splat!

#b#L0#Er, I'm guessing Pwnzer is a reindeer?#l#k
0.4:
Reindeer?  What's that?  No, Pwnzer is an ostrich, of course!  He would be offended if you thought of him as anything but!  Anyway, I yelled "To Elpam Gorlab, Pwnzer, and away!" and lo and behold --POOF!-- I arrived beside Elpam, here by this strange tower, in a completely different world!
In my shock at arriving here -- and to see one our most esteemed Versalians here in a strange new world on Versalmas! -- I almost forgot to give him his present!  Hoy, that would have been a first -- an undelivered gift!  Elpam was just as surprised to see me here -- why, he almost fell down from his perch on that metal tower!  <chuckles> It was a pleasant surprise though, I assume!

#b#L0#I'm sure...#l#k
0.5:
After giving Elpam his gift, which he was happy to receive, I asked him for more information about where "here" was. He told me that this place is called the "Maple World," a place I had only heard about in Versalian legend!  In these tales, it's said that the sun shines in this world everyday!  When Elpam told me that this was actually true, I almost fell over!  And you can imagine how hard that would be to do given my size! <chuckles> I never thought the legends to be true!
Even now, I can hardly believe it!  The welcome sight of an eternal sun swells my chest with happiness! At first, I was at a lost to be in a different world, but I've realized that this also makes the Maple World a perfect place for Versalmas!

#b#L0#A perfect place for Versalmas?  Um... why is that?#l#k
0.6: Because Versalmas is a celebration of the Sun!  You see, in Versal, it is perpetually dark... I believe that you have "night" here as well.  Well, it is night all the time in Versal.  But once a year, our sun comes back... for 30 glorious days straight, which we call the "30 Days of Delight"!  Versalmas Day is the first of these days, and each day after, while the sun shines, we celebrate Versalmas.  Each day of Versalmas, everyone, not just the young, receive gifts from their loved ones. So you see, because the sun shines here in the Maple World every day, why then... it's Versalmas here every day!  Hooray!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Well the gift-giving part sounds a bit like our Maplemas.  Er, have you heard about Maplemas?#l#k
0.7:
That is what everyone I've met has been telling me!  It does seem that your Maplemas is very similar to our Versalmas.  This is quite exciting to me!  Perhaps we can exchange customs and gifts!

#b#L0#What are the differences?  Do you have different foods and traditions for Versalmas?#l#k
#b#L1#That seems to be the problem.  Do you remember a girl named Suzy?  She asked me to speak with you.#l#k
0.8: Ah, I remember speaking with that lovely little child earlier in my walk through New Leaf City --just after I delivered Elpam's gift. She told me about how she loved candy canes, and I told her in turn about our #bSugar-coated Olives#k, which are simply delicious! She seemed very excited about new types of presents and told me all about her #bWishlist#k. My, my, that girl certainly wants quite a few specific things!\r\nSo you say that she needs help to determine whether she should celebrate Versalmas this year?  Hoy, then... would you be kind enough to convey a message to her from me?

yes.0: Thank you.  I understand that she - and you, for that matter - may be used to your own traditions for the holidays.  But I think there's a place for Versalmas here in the Maple World as well.  Please, come back in a little bit and let me think of something appropriately eloquent to say to her.

no.0: I understand that you may think our customs to be strange at first.  But I hope that in time, you will reconsider, and give new customs a chance.  Happy Versalmas!

7.0:
Food, indeed!  Of course!  What is a holiday without food?  Food is one of the hallmarks of Versalmas tradition, and personally my favorite part!
 Whereas you people here enjoy what you call your "#bMaplemas Ham#k," we have #bSmoked Salmon#k for our traditional dinner, which sounds much more delicious to me!  I hope you get the chance to try some!  And perhaps I will try your ham as well!  There are also a host of other traditional holiday dishes, such as those tasty #bCaramel Onions#k and my favorite, #bSugar-coated Olives#k!  I am happy to say that I have a bag full of these with me which I would be happy to share! The most popular Versalmas gifts are gifts of food!
I have also heard that you decorate a tree with lights and ornamentation.  We do the same!  Only we decorate a #bCactus#k instead.  We Versalians sing many of our songs of praise to the sun as we dance around our #bVersalmas Cactus#k!  And... er, you may have noticed that Versalians are somewhat pale.  Because we're no longer used to the bright sunlight, #bSunblock#k is a popular and useful gift for this holiday as well!
It is so strange how we are from different worlds yet we have similar customs!

1.0: Here is my message for the little one called Suzy.\r\nPlease tell her this: As great as Caramel Onions and Sugar-coated Olives may be -- and certainly are! -- Versalmas is about celebrating and sharing the things that we have, and not wanting more than we need.  If Maplemas is like Versalmas, then we both believe in the gift of sharing.  I do believe that even in your world, used to the traditions of Maplemas, there is room for Versalmas as well.\r\nThank you for giving her my message.  I certainly hope Suzy -- and you! -- choose to celebrate Versalmas with me this year!  Happy Versalmas to you, and may your days be bright!

QuestInfo.1:
Jack asked me to take care of 30 of the mighty, lumbering Crimson Guardians and bring him 1 Crimson Heart. The hearts are supposedly rare crystals containing strange energies that power the Guardians.
Jack wants to learn more about the crystals so that perhaps one day he can find an effective way of destroying them.
QuestInfo.2:
*Phew* I managed to take down 30 whole Crimson Guardians! Boy, those monsters are big and scary! As a token of his appreciation, Jack gave me some very handy magic scrolls!

QuestInfo.name: Paving the Way

0.0: Traveller! If you could spare a minute... I could really use your help!
0.1: As you may know, there are large, lumbering behemoths guarding the gate to the Crimsonwood Keep. Well, as it stands, myself and many other adventurers have a hard time slipping past them unscathed, which is detrimental to many expeditions to the Inner Keep. I have been looking for ways to disable the guardians but it's proving to be a real challenge.
0.2: For one, the guardians don't exactly like being experimented upon, and what's more, they are not like other creatures. They are truly unique in that they are neither living, nor undead or robotic. Instead, they seem to be powered by these strange magic crystals called Crimson Hearts... of which I must learn more in order to fully understand how to effectively combat these monsters!
0.3: So what do you think? Would you be able to help me out by bringing me a sample of the crystal I mentioned?

no.0: *Sigh* Very well. Perhaps I will see you around...

yes.0: Thank you so much! Any further information I can gather on the Crimsonwood Keep and its surrounding creatures is of tremendous value, and gaining knowledge of the Crimson Guardians and their hearts is a step in the right direction!

1.0: You have returned, and in one piece, too! What a relief! Did you manage to get your hands on a Crimson Heart?
1.1: Oh, wonderful! This is precisely the stone I was looking for! And it shines with a particularly strong glow, too! A truly excellent specimen!
1.2: Okay, you gave me a helping hand and for that I give you this! Please, consider it a token of my appreciation. Thank you again!

QuestInfo.name: Todd's How-to-Hunt

0.0: Ohh, a new traveller, huh? Don't you want to learn the ways of hunting? Leatty and Drumming Rabbit you see are normally too powerful monsters to be here, or for you to handle. The ones you see here, however, are lacking of any power, thanks to #b#p1032001##k, the head of all magicians who sealed up their power. These are here for the sole purpose of training. Here's your task : Take down #b1 x #o9409000##k and #b1 x #o9409001##k, pick up its dropping, and go see #b#p9101001##k, who should be up there somewhere. It's that easy.

yes.0: As you can see through the Minimap (#bM#k), located on the left corner you'll see something blink on the right side of the map. That's where #b#p9101001##k is. You'll run into Tutorial Leatty and Tutorial Drumming Rabbit on your way to seeing #b#p9101001##k. Defeat #b1 x #o9409000##k and #b1 x #o9409001##k, pick up #r1 x #t4000300##k and #r1 x #t4000301##k, then see #b#p9101001##k.

1.0: Are you the one that #b#p9101002##k is training to hunt? He said something about you having the potential to be a great hunter. Let's see ... let's see if you've trained right.

yes.0: Someday, long after you leave this place, you'll be powerful enough to take on the real Leatty and Drumming Rabbit ... oh, and ... when you level up, make sure to press #bS#k and check out your #bAbility points#k after leveling up.

mob.0: Hmmm ... you should have seen the #bTutorial Leatty#k and #bTutorial Drumming Rabbit#k on the map. Maybe you missed it. All you need to do is attack it by pressing #rCtrl#k and kill it. Once you pick up the dropping, then come back to me.

item.0: Huh? I don't think you have #r1 x #t4000300##k and #r1 x #t4000301##k. When you defeat Tutorial Leatty and Tutorial Drumming Rabit here, Leatty's hariball and Toy drum will be dropped right there on that spot. When that happens, make sure to press #rZ#k to pick up the item. Please hurry!

QuestInfo.name: Around Lith Harbor

0.0: (Olaf breathes in deeply.)\n\rAhhh! Isn't this town great? Blue sky, blue sea... What more could a person ask for?

yes.0: No place on Victoria Island can even begin to compare with Lith Harbor's beauty! But this town offers more than invigorating scenery...
yes.1: Lith Harbor is also a prime location for those just starting out on their training!
yes.2: The monsters nearby aren't too heavily populated or too strong.
yes.3: See for yourself! I heartily recommend that you train on some Ribbon Pigs.
yes.4: If you train diligently, I'll even give you some medicine or whatever else I can scrounge up.
yes.5: Just bring me 1 #t4000017# and 20 #t04000002#s to prove that you've been training. Got it?

no.0: Hm, I guess you're strong enough already that you don't need my help. But since you're here, might as well take a deep breath and enjoy the fresh ocean air.

1.0: Back already? #t4000017#s aren't easy to find. You must find the fresh ocean air as invigorating as I do!
1.1: Here's the reward I promised.
1.2: Stop by and visit every so often, even when you don't need my help. I promise you, the sight of the ocean with do you good!

item.0: Keep an eye out for 1 #t4000017# and 20 #t04000002#s.

QuestInfo.0: #p9110002# at the Mushroom Shrine has something to ask you. Talk to her and find out what she has to say.
QuestInfo.1:
#b#p9110002##k says she wants to take a day off to have a picnic near the shrine, where the cherry blossoms are in full blossom. Bring her some food for her much deserved break.
You can get Maple Special Bento boxes by hunting Blue Mushrooms.

#t2022016# #b#c2022016#/2#k
QuestInfo.2: As a token of appreciation, #b#p9110002##k gave you an item which will help you in your future adventures.\r\nAfter reaching level 30, you can talk to Shururu at the Ninja Castle to begin the next quest.
QuestInfo.name: Relaxing at the Mushroom Shrine

0.0: Whew! I've been simply exhausted lately! Do you have a few moments to let me vent?

yes.0: We've had so many visitors recently. I've had zero downtime. It's just one thing after another, and I'm so stressed out!
yes.1: I need to get rid of some of that stress, and what better way to do that than to eat good food while watching cherry blossoms gently fall?
yes.2: The cherry blossoms are easy to find... The good food? Well, that's where you come in. Can you bring me two delicious #b#t2022016# boxes#k from Blue Mushrooms?
yes.3: Two is too much food for a single person, you say? Oh, no... One of them is for you! I want company on my picnic, of course.
yes.4: I'll be waiting! Just thinking about it calms me down.

no.0: Ah, you're probably as overworked as I am. Well, let me know if you have some free time.

1.0: You brought the bento boxes already? Boy, you must've been hungry yourself.
1.1: That was very kind of you. Thank you. Ah, I already feel rejuvenated.
1.2: And take this as a token of my appreciation. Put it to good use.

item.0: Oh, you don't have 2 #b#t2022016# boxes#k yet. Too bad...

QuestInfo.0: #bShururu#k in Ninja Town is obsessed with making a new top. Find out if there is anything you can do to help.
QuestInfo.1: #bShururu#k says the wood used by ninjas is some of the best in existence. Gather some Genin Dolls for him. \n\n#tGenin Doll 4000337# #b#cGenin Doll#/30#k
QuestInfo.2: #bShururu#k was ecstatic when you brought him the materials for his new top. You're just glad he didn't scream. Screaming toddlers give you a headache.
QuestInfo.name: Playing Around in Ninja Town

0.0: Muahaha! I'm a top-spinning prodigy! I'm the best top spinner in the world! Or so I thought... Do you have time to listen to a tragic story about a poor, innocent boy?

yes.0: See, I'm the best top spinner in town by far. So I thought I was the best in the world. But then I went to compete in a national competition and learned that I was merely a big fish in a minuscule pond...
yes.1: I lost in the first round. Then I lost again in the consolation round.
yes.2: I was devastated! How could that have happened?! But then I realized... I was the only guy there using a store-bought top!
yes.3: I needed to make my own custom top. So I asked around, and the grown ups told me the best tops are made with the best wood: the dense, sturdy wood of #bGenin Dolls#k. So that's what I need.
yes.4: But I'm a toddler and a top-spinning genius, not a fighter...
yes.5: But you. You seem like you know how to handle yourself in combat.
yes.6: Swear that you'll get me 50 #bGenin Dolls#k or else I'll start screaming! I'll be waiting right here, showing off my skills, until your return.

no.0: Ah, guess you're no one special. Alright, well, see you around I guess.

1.0: Aw shucks, you got me the stuff I asked for. I knew I could count on you. Here, I don't need this. You have it.
1.1: Now I'll build my own custom top and blow those other guys out of the water! Muahaha!
1.2: Hey, I'm a busy guy. I gotta jet. See ya.

item.0: I told you, if you don't get me 50 #bGenin Dolls#k I am going to scream and scream and cause a huge scene...

QuestInfo.0: #p9110112# is looking for help. Go and find out what this is about.
QuestInfo.1: You have been given a top secret mission from #p9110112#. Gather 100 #b#t04000338#s#k from #b#o9400401##k? What will he do with them? \n\n#t04000338# #b#c04000338##k/100
QuestInfo.2: You delivered 100 #t04000338#s to #p9110112#. He probably isn't planning on using it for anything bad... Or is he?
QuestInfo.name: A Little Mischief

0.0: Hey, you. I've got something to say. Got a minute?

yes.0: Tsk, people talk about me behind my back, but I'm not so bad. Especially if you do me a favor...
yes.1: Inside Ninja Castle, you'll find a lot of #b#o9400401##k running about. They carry #b#t04000338#s#k... I'd, heh, greatly appreciate it if you could get me 100.
yes.2: The poison used in #b#t04000338#s#k is simply fantastic. Great, great quality stuff. Oopsies, shouldn't have said that. Tsk, anyway. Just get me 100 #b#t04000338#s#k. You will, of course, be compensated.

no.0: Tsk, you've got to learn about life. If you're not wise, you'll always get the short end of the stick.

1.0: Done already? Very nice. Very nice indeed. Okay, now it's my turn to give YOU something.
1.1: Now, you know what'll happen if you tell anyone about this, right? Don't breathe a word of it... Or else.

item.0: Tsk, you didn't collect 100 #b#t04000338#s#k yet... Better hurry up if you know what's good for you. I mean, eh, thanks for your help!

QuestInfo.0: #p9110112#'s daughter, #p9110103#, seems pensive. Find out what's making her worry.
QuestInfo.1: #p9110103# has asked you to find someone to help you investigate Ninja Castle. But where will you find someone to help you investigate such an unsettling castle?
QuestInfo.2: You found someone who is willing to investigate the castle with you!
QuestInfo.name: Helping Others

0.0: Excuse me. Would you... Would you do me a favor?
0.1: It's about my father, who runs the clothing store. His name is Kamedeya, but he doesn't exactly have the best reputation...
0.2: That's because he's teamed up with the castellan of Ninja Castle to engage in illegal poison trafficking.
0.3: He's collecting poison used by #o9400401# and selling it on the black market. He gives a portion of the profits to the castellan and they both profit.
0.4: But my father's being tricked! He has to be! My father was always a good-hearted, kind man! The castellan was also known for his gentle manners and love for the people. Something's happened to both of them and I am determined to get to the bottom of this!
0.5: But I need your help. I've tried to ask others, but everyone is too scared to even look in the direction of Ninja Castle because of the deadly ninjas inside...
0.6: I'd go myself, but I got into an argument with the gatekeeper and have been banned from the castle. So please, could you help? Please, please, please?

yes.0: Thank you! According to what I've heard, someone is already investigating the castle. I'd like you to meet up with that person. I don't know who it is, though, or why they're there, or where they are, or anything. I'm sorry I can't be more help.

no.0: Oh, no worries. I'm asking you to risk your life, after all. I'll just have to find someone who's braver. Thank you anyway.

1.0: What brings you to a place like this...?
1.1: What did you say!? You think there's something wrong with the castellan?! How did you--
1.2: Ah, that kid #p9110103# must've told you. Well, then, I guess you can be trusted. I'll fill you in. You see, someone's asked me to investigate the castle, too, and that's exactly what I've been doing.
1.3: Just wait here for a minute while I go and report this unexpected occurrence. I'll be right back. Talk to me in just a few minutes.

npc.0: You didn't discover anything yet? Oh, please do go find the other person investigating Ninja Castle!

QuestInfo.0: #p9110114# seems willing to accept you as an ally. Find out the details.
QuestInfo.1: Now you must prove your abilities. Collect 50 #b#t04000344#s#k from the #b#o9400406##k and deliver them to the #b#p9110108##k. \n\n#t04000344# #b#c04000344##k/50
QuestInfo.2: You collected 50 #t04000344#s and delivered them to #p9110108#.
QuestInfo.name: Cooperation

0.0: Excellent timing. I just got back.
0.1: I spoke to #bthe One Who Has Come#k  about us working together and he has agreed, so I will lend you my aid.
0.2: The deeper we venture into the castle, the more dangerous it will get. I'll look bad if I send someone incompetent, no offense, so I have to test your skills first. Plus, I don't want you to get hurt.
0.3: So, do you accept my test?

yes.0: Good answer.
yes.1: This should be fairly easy. Please bring me 50 #b#t04000344#s#k, which drop off the #b#o9400406##k.
yes.2: When you have them, deliver them to the #b#p9110108##k. He's been asking for them for a while, but I haven't quite catch up with him myself.

no.0: Oh, come on. Be brave!

1.0: Ah, I sense that you bring with you something... magnificent!
1.1: Indeed, you carry with you #t04000344#s. I can tell.
1.2: #p9110114# must have sent you. Poor soul. I know he's tried to deliver these to me a few times already, but I never stay in one place for long.
1.3: So! You are working with #p9110114# at the behest of the lady #p9110103#? And by delivering the #t04000344#s, you have passed Nagare's test. Yes, I know all. I have eyes everywhere. And I find you more than capable for this job.
1.4: As for what's going on in the castle... Let's just say I've... ordered an investigation. \r\n(He and his falcon share a knowing look.) \r\nAnyway, stay patient and keep training. I will contact you when they return with news.

npc.0: Deliver 50 #b#t04000344#s#k dropped by #b#o9400406##k to the #b#p9110108##k.

QuestInfo.0: Ask #p9110108# to share the current situation with you.
QuestInfo.1:
#p9110108# has requested that you collect 50 #b#t04000340#s#k from #b#o9400403##k and 1 #b#t04000342##k from the #b#o9400405##k to deliver to someone. But who...? 

#t04000340# #b#c04000340##k/50
#k#t04000342# #b#c04000342##k/1

QuestInfo.name: Collecting Info

0.0: Sorry to have kept you waiting. I've discovered what's happening in the castle.
0.1: Things don't look too good. The castle is being ruled by a monster of some sort, and he has a bunch of underlings with him. The castle's like a maze, and a lot of people who go in never find their way back out...
0.2: So I'd like to ask you to do something for me. There are #b#o9400403##k and #b#o9400405##k in the castle. I'd like you to collect the #b#t04000340#s#k and #b#t04000342##k from them.
0.3: I think the #b#t04000340#s#k may contain the secret to defeating the fake castellan. Perhaps it contains instructions for a powerful attack? Anyway, I want to pass one out to everyone, so get me 50 of them. A single #b#t04000342##k should be sufficient, though, I think.

QuestInfo.1: I met a knight lost in the Phantom Forest named #bLukan de Vrisien#k.  His armor is very ancient-looking, and he seems to be from another era.  Lukan asked if I knew anything about the unfriendly #bStormbreaker#k warriors wandering the forest.  He seems to hate them, though strangely, his armor looks almost exactly like theirs... lightning bolts and all!  Regarding this, Lukan remains tight-lipped... at least until I prove I'm not in league with them.  To gain his trust, and prove my fighting prowess, I need to #bdefeat these Stormbreakers#k and #bcollect 10 of their badges#k to bring to him.
QuestInfo.2: After defeating the Stormbreakers as he requested, Lukan explained that he is a #bStormcaster Knight#k from Crimsonwood Keep.  When I told him that Crimsonwood Keep was ancient history, and that Masteria had been lost for a millenium, he seemed at a loss for words.  Somehow, he has been transported to this time period, his future.  Strange things are brewing indeed.
QuestInfo.name: The Brewing Storm

item.0: #b10 Stormbreaker Badges#k were the terms of the challenge... and you are still shy of that number.  By accepting those terms of my challenge, you are honor-bound to bring me exactly 10, and no fewer.  Return when you have acquired all of them.

QuestInfo.0: To enter the Grandmaster Hall of Crimsonwood Keep and find the new twisted Masters, Jack Barricade says I'll need to find some way to open the gate to the Keep's Inner Sanctum.  Perhaps someone who has firsthand knowledge of the Keep will know what I need... and I know just who to ask!

Being a well-respected Stormcaster Knight, he was given a #bCrimsonwood Keystone#k by the Keep's Grandmasters.  However, Lukan thinks that I'm mad to assault the castle and refuses to give me the key, calling it a suicide mission.  However, if I can whittle down the Keep's defenders, he'll relent and give me the Keystone.  I've already put the hurt on the Stormbreakers, but I'll need to defeat at least #b75 Windraiders, 75 Firebrands#k, and #b75 Nightshadows#k more to put a sizeable enough dent in this evil army!
QuestInfo.2:
I defeated the twisted Crimsonwood warriors!  And true to his word, Lukan gave me his 
#bCrimsonwood Keystone#k.  He also said that 
although the Keystone will physically unlock the 
Inner Sanctum Gate, the red energy field that surrounds them is foreign to him, and likely a new addition by the Keep's new Masters.  I should take the key back to Jack Barricade and let him know what I've discovered.

Taggrin said that there was one thing I could do however: #bcut down the possessed Phantom Trees#b and bring him #b50#k of their #bseeds#k. He explained that he was forced to steal it from Taggrin, who had refused to give it to him even after he'd won it in a bet fair and square.  Now that Jack's made it up to the Crimsonwood Mountain, he's given the map to me for my own use.  Perhaps I should return it to Taggrin?  If I keep it, the map will come in handy while navigating the tricky Phantom Forest, #ballowing me to use the marked shortcuts#k and save time traveling. QuestInfo.1: I told Taggrin that I'd found Jack up the Crimsonwood Mountain, and explained Jack's purpose.  Taggrin was surprised when I offered to return his Map of Phantom Forest to him... and was moved by my gesture. He seems to have warmed up to me, and ask that I return and speak to him. What could he want?
QuestInfo.2:
In return for making the honorable gesture of returning his map, Taggrin let me in on a secret of his own: he and his band are not bandits at all, but are actually #bRaven Ninjas#k, descendants of the ancient #bShadowknights#k!  They're here to discover what happened to their ancestral Keep and the reason behind the disappearance of Masteria. As such, Taggrin is offering a bounty on the Keep's unrightful occupiers.  I can now speak to Joko to redeem any #rBadges#k I find off these corrupted warriors (the #rWindraiders#k, the #rStormbreakers#k, the 
#rFirebrands#k, and the #rNightshadows#k) for 
#bmeso bounties#k, and possibly even #bRaven 
Ninja gear#k!
I can make #bone Badge Bounty Redemption per day#k.
QuestInfo.name: The Right Path

1.0: I want to thank you again for returning our map.  This gesture tells me something of who you are.  Perhaps someone to be trusted... a potential ally.  Time will tell if my faith is misplaced.
1.1: You asked me once what we were, if not bandits. <smiles> So I tell you this now: We are members of the #bRaven Ninja Clan#k, and hail from an island called the Isle of Vigilance off the northern shores of Masteria.
1.2: We Raven Ninjas trace our lineage back to the ancient Masterian guild of the #bShadowknights#k, so you could consider Crimsonwood Keep our ancestral home.  Our mission here is to discover the reason for Masteria's disappearance and its return.  It is almost certainly tied with the current events at the Keep, and what you and this Jack Barricade are pursuing.
1.3: Based on what you have told me, I have expanded our mission to include the elimination of these trespassers that now occupy Crimsonwood Keep.  <smiles>  It's what we do best.  But we will #bpay a bounty for the badges#k of those you happen to dispatch as well.  Consider yourself a contractor.  My brother #bJoko#k will handle the details so you should speak to him.

yes.0: Oh, and keep this map.  Jack may have been right to entrust you with it.  Until we meet again, friend.

QuestInfo.0: I should speak to Taggrin to see if he has another task for me.
QuestInfo.1: Taggrin has one more task for me: he wants me to hunt down the #bElder Wraiths#k and collect #b50 of their Elder Ashes#k.  Warning me that this would be no easy task, he explained that the wraiths are the souls of brave Crimsonwood Keep warriors who fell in battle in the forest, protecting the Keep from the invading Krakians.  Never given a proper burial, they have become mindless undead, threatening the Keep's foes and innocent travelers alike.  With these ashes, Taggrin intends to give these noble lost souls the final rest they so rightfully deserve.
QuestInfo.2: Taggrin was impressed that I manage to collect the ashes from the Elder Wraiths.  I can now speak to #bFiona#k about #bupgrading any Raven Ninja gear#k I may have!  Taggrin also mentioned that the talented ninja smith has experimented with some weapon designs of her own; I should speak to her about the possibility of\n#bcrafting new items#k from scratch.
QuestInfo.name: The Fallen Warriors

1.0: The ashes!  If I may take them from you?  Please... handle them with reverence
1.1: You have earned my respect.  While you are not one of us, I welcome you as a fellow clan member.

yes.0: Go speak to Fiona.  In addition to being a skilled fighter, she is a talented weapon smith.  If you have earned any of our Raven gear from Joko, Fiona can reforge these items to become even more powerful than they already are.  You may also wish to speak to her about some of her unique creations.

QuestInfo.0: I should see if Jack Barricade needs my help with anything...
QuestInfo.1: Jack needs John's help, and needs me to be the go-between.  He wants me to deliver a letter to his brother in NLC; the #bCoded Communique#k contains a transcription of some strange symbol code that he saw while being held in Crimsonwood Keep.  Hopefully, with his expertise in ancient languages, John should be able to decipher it.  I should hop to it!  I have a feeling some serious events are unfolding...
QuestInfo.2: Looks like Jack was right about the symbols he saw in the Grandmaster Council Hall; the Versalian code seems to indicate that the new Masters are planning to attack NLC with the soldiers they're training!  It's going to be up to us to stop them!
QuestInfo.name: Lost in Translation 1

1.0: You found my brother?!  Wonderful!  Glad to hear that he's alive and kicking.

npc.0: You're back!  What does the code mean?  What did John say?  What?!  You guys haven't figured it out yet!?  What are you waiting for?!  We need to find out what this means immediately!

QuestInfo.0: I should see if John needs my help with anything...
QuestInfo.1: After showing John the #bCoded Communique#k that Jack gave me, John used a Hyper Glyph to try to decipher the symbols... to no avail.  While John attempts to fix and recalibrate the Hyper Glyphs to work on these symbols, he asked me to show the letter around to the #bother experts in town#k.  Maybe they can shine some light on all this...
QuestInfo.2: I told John about Elpam's translation, and John was able to fill in some more of the blanks for me.  I need to get this new information Jack and see what else he knows...
QuestInfo.name: Lost in Translation 2

item.0: I'm still trying to get these darn Hyper Glyphs to work!  Have you spoken to the others in NLC?  No?  Hop to it, then!  We can't let Jack down.  #bProfessor Foxwit#k, #bMayor Slimm#k, or #bLita#k might all know something about this.  Who knows, maybe even the #bGlimmer Man#k or #bElpam#k may have come across this writing before!  Cover all the angles, kid!

QuestInfo.1: I must traverse Crimsonwood Mountain and get this new information Jack and see what else he knows...!
QuestInfo.2: I reached Jack and gave him the info-he's going through it all now...

QuestInfo.1: Someone who has firsthand knowledge of the Keep.  I think I have an idea who might be able to help.

QuestInfo.1: I'm helping Mom and Dad make Thanksgiving dinner! I have to gather one of each ingredient: 1 ear of #b#t2020029##k, a can of #b#t2022262##k, a #b#t2022263##k, bowl of #b#t2022264##k and best of all, #b#t2022261##k. I guess they think that without the fixins', there'll be no dinner!  No dinner?  No way!  Time to defeat some battle-hardened Turkeys!
QuestInfo.2: My trusty weapon did a fine job of ruffling those rowdy turkeys' feathers, and I obtained all of the ingredients for Mom and Dad. In return, they gave me my #b#t4031529##k! Mom mentioned that I can help her with dinner once a day until it's time to eat!

QuestInfo.0: There's a little girl with a puzzled look on her face in New Leaf City.  With X-mas time just around the corner, she should be happy... I wonder why she looks so puzzled and confused instead?  Looks like she may need some help with her Maplemas spirit!
QuestInfo.1: Little Suzy was all excited for Maplemas this year... until she learned all about a similar holiday called "Versalmas" from a strange green mouse named O-Pongo.  Now she doesn't know what sounds more exciting - Maplemas... or Versalmas?  Suzy needs my help to help her decide which version of X-mas she should celebrate this year.  In order to do that, I'll have to speak to both Maple Claws and this O-Pongo character, and then come back and talk to her.  Maplemas holiday from an alternate dimension, huh?  Very curious...
QuestInfo.2: I spoke to both Maple Claws and O-Pongo.  It seems that both Maplemas and Versalmas have their merits.  In the end, Suzy's put the decision on me: she's asked me to deliver her X-mas Wishlist to one of the two "Santas," which will determine which holiday she's celebrating this year.  I have a feeling that this decision is important, that I'm not just making a choice for her... but also one for myself.  Which holiday do I believe in?
QuestInfo.name: Little Suzy's X-Mas Dilemma

0.0:
Ok!  My question is: what's better...  Maplemas or Versalmas?

#b#L0#Versalmas?!  What are you talking about, little girl?  There's no such thing as Versalmas!#l#k
#b#L1#Listen, little girl, I've got more important things to do than answer stupid kid questions.#l
0.1: I'm not little!  I'm 10 years old!  And there is too such a thing as Versalmas!  O-Pongo told me all about it!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#O-Pongo?  Um, right... I suppose this "O-Pongo" is your invisible "friend."#l
0.2: No, silly!  O-Pongo is real!  He's right here in New Leaf City... go look if you don't believe me!  He's just like Maple Claws except he's big and green and a mouse and wears purple instead of red!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Ok...#l
0.3: Well, maybe he's not exactly alike, but he's the Maple Claws from his world -- the world of Versal!  O-Pongo told me all about it!  He told me about how it's usually dark but that the sun shines day after day after Versalmas comes and how all the kids dance and sing together and get special treats and candies!  It sounds very exciting--more exciting than Maplemas!  Well, maybe not more-- I do like all the presents I get from my parents on Maplemas.  But you get presents for Versalmas too!  I was already going to ask Maple Claws for a new pair of skis and other stuff, but I don't know what kind of presents since I've never had Versalmas before... so maybe Versalmas presents are even better!  But Maplemas Trees are so pretty and I love decorating them!  So-- Oh, I don't know!  Both holidays sound so good but I don't know if I'm allowed to celebrate both...\r\n<looks sad>\r\nPlease... can you... can you help me decide?  You're older than I am... you should know!  Pleaaaaase!

yes.0: Yayyyyyyy!  Please, go talk to O-Pongo!  He can tell you all about Versalmas!  And please speak to Maple Claws too... she's in Happyville as usual, of course!  I'm sure you know this already but you can get to Happyville by speaking to #bRooney#k, and she'll take you there.  Then come back and tell me which holiday I should celebrate!  I've been working on my wishlist all year long and I know I'm going to get everything on it because I've been a really good girl!  Please, hurry!  I need to know who's bringing me presents this year!\r\nI can't wait to hear back from you!  Both holidays sound so great!  I can't wait to celebrate, uh--the right holiday!

no.0: I thought being older means you know more but I guess not.  Hmmph!

0.1: This is not a stupid question!  This is very important!  You're a meanie... a stupid meanie with no holiday spirit!

1.0: So, you spoke to both of them?  And what did they say?  Really?  Uh-huh.  And?  Maple Claws said that?  Wow... I love her!  And what about Versalmas?  O-Pongo said that?  Really?!  Wow.  I'm really glad you told me that.  I feel like I know much more about both holidays now!
1.1: Oh...\r\nThis doesn't make my decision any easier at all!\r\nWhat am I going to do?
1.2: I know!  You're older than I am... you know what to do!  Please, take the #bwishlist#k I've made!  You decide for me!  Please give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo!  But please think about this very carefully!  It's an important decision... for both me and you.

yes.0: Thank you very much!  Please let me know who you gave my list to... so I'll know who's bringing me presents this year!

quest.0: So, who's going to be bringing me my presents this year?  You don't know yet?!  Please, I can't stand not knowing!  Please talk to both Maple Claws and O-Pongo and come back!

QuestInfo.0: To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to Maple Claws.  I'm sure she's back in town now in Happyville.
QuestInfo.1: To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to Maple Claws about Suzy's dilemma.  Maple Claws listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy.  I should talk to her in a bit.
QuestInfo.2: Maple Claws gave me a message for Suzy: that as long as she remembers the essence of the Maplemas Spirit, it doesn't really matter what holiday traditions she chooses to follow this year.  I should return to Suzy with Maple Claws' message once I've also spoken to O-Pongo.
QuestInfo.name: The Spirit of Maplemas

0.0:
Merry Maplemas to you, Mapler!  Are you ready to celebrate Maplemas this year?  I hope you've been good...

#b#L0#I've been an excellent kid!#l#k
#b#L1#I've actually been burning ants and stuff!#l
0.1:
Have you?  We'll see once I check my list... <purrs>
<sigh> But as it turns out, I have a situation that needs everyone's help this year!  Even if you've been bad, here's a chance to do some good for others and still receive presents from me this year.

#b#L0#Sure, Maple Claws.  What happened?  What do you need?#l
0.2: Every year as you know, I begin collecting presents for all the kids in the Maple World that have been good.  It's a lot of presents so it takes quite awhile... all year in fact!  My helpers and I had finally finished gathering them all when my present storehouse was broken into... and a bunch of the presents were stolen!  These were presents that were already wrapped and simply waiting for delivery!  Without these presents and with Maplemas Day so near, thousands of children in the Maple World will go without presents this year!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#That's terrible! I'd be glad to help you with that, of course!#l
0.3: Thank you, I knew you had the Maplemas spirit in you.  I know who's taken my presents: monsters.  Monsters simply have no manners, taking what's not theirs, but they love presents as much as any kid.  In a way, my heart goes out to them. <sigh> If you happen to find any presents from any bad monsters who've taken them from me, please return them to me as soon as you can.  Hmmm.  But I sense that there's another reason why you've come to see me.\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Yes, Maple Claws, a little girl named Suzy asked me to speak with you.#l
0.4: So, Suzy is having a hard time finding her Maplemas spirit this year?  I see.  Sometimes, with the hustle and bustle of everyday life, it's easy for us to forget to treat each other with simple kindnesses.  This is why the holidays are important... it's a time to let us remember the best in us and our fellow Maplers.  But something tells me there's something more to Suzy's dilemma.\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Yes, she spoke to a mouse named O-Pongo who told her about something called Versalmas.  Some sort of alternate Maplemas.#l
0.5: Ah.  I've heard of this O-Pongo.  You say he's a mouse who talks of an alternate version of Maplemas?  Curious.  But it does not surprise me that alternate worlds would celebrate holidays in different ways.\r\nI see that Suzy is excited at the prospect of a different holiday, and likely, different presents.  <purrs in thought>  Very well, will you take her a message from me?

yes.0: Thank you.  It's important that little boys and girls don't forget what it is about the spirit of Maplemas that is important.  Please give me a moment to think about what I should exactly say to her, and then come back to me.

no.0: Part of the Maplemas spirit is spreading the spirit to those who have need of it. I hope you come back when you've found it within you.

0.1: I had a feeling I'd seen a lump of coal with your name on it lying around somewhere in my present storehouse.  Tsk, tsk.

1.0: I've thought of what I need you to tell Suzy.\r\nPlease tell her this: As long as she holds the spirit of kindness and goodwill in her heart all year round, it doesn't matter whether she chooses to celebrate the holidays with a Maplemas Tree, or with Versalmas customs and gifts.  Tell her that as long as she doesn't forget that, Maple Claws will remember her and bring her presents every year.\r\nWill you tell her that?  You will?  Thank you, and a Merry Maplemas to you, too!

QuestInfo.0: To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to O-Pongo.  I'd better speak with this strange green mouse and find out more details about Versalmas.
QuestInfo.1: To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to O-Pongo about Suzy's dilemma.  O-Pongo listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy.  I should talk to her in a bit.
QuestInfo.2: Versal Power! I spoke with O-Pongo, the Versalmas Mouse, who is the "Santa" for the Versal version of Maplemas, and learned a great deal about Versalmas.  He told me about the customs for their holiday--quite different from the Maple World! The world of Versal is usually shrouded in darkness; Versalmas is an annual holiday that celebrates the emergence of the sun in their world, which shines for 90 straight days and only for these 90 days.  For Versalmas, children receive presents every day for the first 30 days, and get cool treats like Sugar-coated Olives and Caramel Onions! Sounds pretty awesome... Now I'd better speak with Maple Claws and head back to Suzy... It makes me wonder for myself though, which holiday would I pick to celebrate?  Hmmm...
QuestInfo.name: A Versal Tradition

0.0: Hoy there, young friend!  My, my, what a beautiful world you live in!  Who am I?  Why, I am O-Pongo!  Nice to meet you!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Nice to meet you too, er, O-Pongo.  So what are you doing here in NLC?#l#k
0.1: I'm here because it's that time of year!  It's Versalmas time again!  I'm the Versalmas Mouse so I'm here to spread Versalmas cheer!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Versalmas?  What's that?#l#k
0.2: Why, Versalmas is the most wonderful holiday in all of Versal!  How wonderful?  Why, so wonderful that everyone loves Versalmas!  Versalmas is even better than birthdays!  Why, just imagine the best birthday you've ever had... and Versalmas is a hundred times better than that!  It's the most celebrated holiday in Versal!  Well... it's actually the only holiday celebrated in Versal.  But it's still wonderful, nonetheless!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Um, so why are you here?  Shouldn't you be in Versal for that?#l#k
0.3:
As for why I'm here, it's a strange story.  As the Versalmas Mouse, I'm bound by Versalmas law to deliver a present to every Versalian, no matter how far and wide they are located in Versal.  Whew, it's no easy task I tell you!  I had crossed off everyone on my list except for one last name -- Elpam Gorlab!
I had Elpam's gift all ready to go, but I couldn't find him anywhere!  So, I asked my trusty steed, Pwnzer, to "sniff" out where he was, and take me to him, crackity-splat!

#b#L0#Er, I'm guessing Pwnzer is a reindeer?#l#k
0.4:
Reindeer?  What's that?  No, Pwnzer is an ostrich, of course!  He would be offended if you thought of him as anything but!  Anyway, I yelled "To Elpam Gorlab, Pwnzer, and away!" and lo and behold --POOF!-- I arrived beside Elpam, here by this strange tower, in a completely different world!
In my shock at arriving here -- and to see one our most esteemed Versalians here in a strange new world on Versalmas! -- I almost forgot to give him his present!  Hoy, that would have been a first -- an undelivered gift!  Elpam was just as surprised to see me here -- why, he almost fell down from his perch on that metal tower!  <chuckles> It was a pleasant surprise though, I assume!

#b#L0#I'm sure...#l#k
0.5:
After giving Elpam his gift, which he was happy to receive, I asked him for more information about where "here" was. He told me that this place is called the "Maple World," a place I had only heard about in Versalian legend!  In these tales, it's said that the sun shines in this world everyday!  When Elpam told me that this was actually true, I almost fell over!  And you can imagine how hard that would be to do given my size! <chuckles> I never thought the legends to be true!
Even now, I can hardly believe it!  The welcome sight of an eternal sun swells my chest with happiness! At first, I was at a lost to be in a different world, but I've realized that this also makes the Maple World a perfect place for Versalmas!

#b#L0#A perfect place for Versalmas?  Um... why is that?#l#k
0.6: Because Versalmas is a celebration of the Sun!  You see, in Versal, it is perpetually dark... I believe that you have "night" here as well.  Well, it is night all the time in Versal.  But once a year, our sun comes back... for 30 glorious days straight, which we call the "30 Days of Delight"!  Versalmas Day is the first of these days, and each day after, while the sun shines, we celebrate Versalmas.  Each day of Versalmas, everyone, not just the young, receive gifts from their loved ones. So you see, because the sun shines here in the Maple World every day, why then... it's Versalmas here every day!  Hooray!\r\n\r\n#b#L0#Well the gift-giving part sounds a bit like our Maplemas.  Er, have you heard about Maplemas?#l#k
0.7:
That is what everyone I've met has been telling me!  It does seem that your Maplemas is very similar to our Versalmas.  This is quite exciting to me!  Perhaps we can exchange customs and gifts!

#b#L0#What are the differences?  Do you have different foods and traditions for Versalmas?#l#k
#b#L1#That seems to be the problem.  Do you remember a girl named Suzy?  She asked me to speak with you.#l#k
0.8: Ah, I remember speaking with that lovely little child earlier in my walk through this wonderful city--just after I delivered Elpam's gift. She told me about how she loved candy canes, and I told her in turn about our #bSugar-coated Olives#k, which are simply delicious! She seemed very excited about new types of presents and told me all about her #bWishlist#k. My, my, that girl certainly wants quite a few specific things!\r\nSo you say that she needs help to determine whether she should celebrate Versalmas this year?  Hoy, then... would you be kind enough to convey a message to her from me?

yes.0: Thank you.  I understand that she - and you, for that matter - may be used to your own traditions for the holidays.  But I think there's a place for Versalmas here in the Maple World as well.  Please, come back in a little bit and let me think of something appropriately eloquent to say to her.

no.0: I understand that you may think our customs to be strange at first.  But I hope that in time, you will reconsider, and give new customs a chance.  Happy Versalmas!

7.0:
Food, indeed!  Of course!  What is a holiday without food?  Food is one of the hallmarks of Versalmas tradition, and personally my favorite part!
 Whereas you people here enjoy what you call your "#bMaplemas Ham#k," we have #bSmoked Salmon#k for our traditional dinner, which sounds much more delicious to me!  I hope you get the chance to try some!  And perhaps I will try your ham as well!  There are also a host of other traditional holiday dishes, such as those tasty #bCaramel Onions#k and my favorite, #bSugar-coated Olives#k!  I am happy to say that I have a bag full of these with me which I would be happy to share! The most popular Versalmas gifts are gifts of food!
I have also heard that you decorate a tree with lights and ornamentation.  We do the same!  Only we decorate a #bCactus#k instead.  We Versalians sing many of our songs of praise to the sun as we dance around our #bVersalmas Cactus#k!  And... er, you may have noticed that Versalians are somewhat pale.  Because we're no longer used to the bright sunlight, #bSunblock#k is a popular and useful gift for this holiday as well!
It is so strange how we are from different worlds yet we have similar customs!

1.0: Here is my message for the little one called Suzy.\r\nPlease tell her this: As great as Caramel Onions and Sugar-coated Olives may be -- and certainly are! -- Versalmas is about celebrating and sharing the things that we have, and not wanting more than we need.  If Maplemas is like Versalmas, then we both believe in the gift of sharing.  I do believe that even in your world, used to the traditions of Maplemas, there is room for Versalmas as well.\r\nThank you for giving her my message.  I certainly hope Suzy -- and you! -- choose to celebrate Versalmas with me this year!  Happy Versalmas to you, and may your days be bright!

Not only that, I'll also have to pick up the glass shoes that have been dropped into the Ligator swamps by an angel. I better gather them all up before it's too late.
QuestInfo.name: Ponlaa's Party Dress & Glass Shoes
QuestInfo.parent: The Ugly's Quest for Beauty ll

yes.0: I'm in dire need of some high-quality Turkey Eggs for a Thanksgiving breakfast I'm cooking. Will you gather some #bYellow Turkey Eggs#k for me? Yellow Turkey Eggs can be obtained from tamed turkeys. Good luck!

no.0: Oh, ok.  Be sure to come back, because I won't wait forever to get my eggs!

1.0: Excellent work! That is a fine Turkey egg you've got...in return, let me dig around in the backpack here...I think I do have something here for you...

yes.0: Take this and I hope it helps out in your travels! Thank you! Find me more eggs and I'll reward you!

item.0: Hmm, looks like your bag has some lint, but no #bYellow Turkey Eggs#k! Collect some #bYellow Turkey Eggs#k and I'll make it worth your while!

QuestInfo.0: It looks like Cody of Henesys needs help finding Turkey eggs...
QuestInfo.1:
I'm on a mission to find as many #b Green Turkey eggs#k as I can for Cody, who has a strange liking for Turkey Egg omelets. I'm going to find as many as I can and bring them back to him for prizes! I've heard wild turkeys can be found around Ossyria and Sleepywood.

I spoke with that kind old woman, Grandma Benson, and she needs some help with baking the pies. I've agreed to gather #bthe ingredients#k for her, maybe she'll give me a pie to take with me... She suggested I should visit YokoYoko, Jiyur, Tangyoon, and Olivia.

QuestInfo.name: Thanksgiving : Pumpkin Pie

0.0: My, you look like a fine young spirit! Care to help me out?

yes.0: Great! I'm trying to make some pie, but need some help gathering the ingredients! I'm sure gathering them will be no problem for a seasoned adventurer like yourself! I'll need #bPie Crust#k from #rJiyur#k, #bPumpkin#k from #rOlivia#k, #bFlour#k from #rYokoYoko#k, and #bSugar#k from #rTangyoon#k. And, if you help me out with this 10 times I'll give you a Pumpkin Pie Ring for your troubles!

no.0: Darn, I was hoping you'd help! Oh well, come back and see me soon!

1.0: Fantastic! This looks like enough to make the pie. As promised, here is a reward for your kindness. Don't let it get cold, eat up!

yes.0: Thanks for your help! There's also a contest to see which guild can gather the most Pumpkin Pies. Check Nexon.net for details and come back soon!

item.0: I don't think you have everything yet. Trying to fool an old woman? I've been your age, but you've never been mine. Remember, I need #bPie Crust#k from #rJiyur#k, #bPumpkin#k from #rOlivia#k, #bFlour#k from #rYokoYoko#k, and #bSugar#k from #rTangyoon#k.! Get going!

QuestInfo.0: Hmm, that woman looks like she's preparing some sort of celebration... I should check it out.
QuestInfo.1: I spoke with Hannah, and she's preparing a Festival of Lights. I've agreed to help her build the Altar by gathering 25 Altar Pieces. She mentioned that the monsters would already have an axe stuck in them, so I should hunt those.
QuestInfo.2: I collected the 25 Altar Pieces and returned to Hannah. She was happy, and began building the Altar. She also mentioned that I could come back for more work when I have a chance
QuestInfo.name: Festival of Lights - Building the Altar

0.0: Greetings, traveler. My name is Hannah and I'm currently organizing a Festival of Lights for the Holidays. If you could help me out, I'd greatly appreciate it!

yes.0: Excellent. I'd like to build an altar for the festival, so we'll need 25 Altar Pieces. Some others attempted to help me, but their axes got stuck in the wood. Fighting those monsters should give you the needed pieces. Thank you and hurry back!

no.0: Truly a shame, I suppose that I will have to find another good soul to assist me...Fare thee well!

1.0: Wonderful! These should be enough pieces to build the Altar. Thanks for your help! I've got one other thing for you when you get a chance...

yes.0: Ok, I'll start building the Altar. In the meantime, I'll need you to gather 9 Sabbath Candles so we can officially start the festival. They can be found on those strange horned mushroom creatures.

item.0: Oh my, it looks like you don't have enough pieces to build the altar yet. Be sure to hurry back when you do!

QuestInfo.0: I promised Hannah I'd return to her once I was rested up. I should head back soon.
QuestInfo.1: Upon my return, Hannah was joyous, having finished the Altar. She now needs candles to signal the start of the ceremony. I'll have to get 9 candles (she mentioned Horned Mushrooms) and bring them back so the Festival of Lights can begin.
QuestInfo.2: I acquired the nine candles and gave them to Hannah. The Festival of Lights has begun!
QuestInfo.name: Festival of Lights - Blessing the Festival

0.0: I'll start building the Altar. In the meantime, I'll need you to gather 9 Sabbath Candles so we can officially start the festival. If you could help me out, I'd greatly appreciate it!

yes.0: Glad to hear it. Ok, They can be found on those strange horned mushroom creatures. Come back here when you've got 9!

no.0: Alright. I still need your help, though, so be sure to come back!

1.0: Great job! I think these candles will be enough to begin the Festival of Lights! Thanks for your hard work, please take this present as a token of my appreciation.

yes.0: Thanks again! If you want to open this present box, then would you like me to help you open up the present?

item.0: Ah, you've returned...with not enough candles, I see. I'll need 9 to start the Festival. See you when you get them!

QuestInfo.0: What is that old man doing over there with all those Graham Crackers?
QuestInfo.1: I spoke with the old man, Mr. Kit Kat, and he wants to build a Graham Cracker house, but the monsters keep eating them...not that I blame them, they look delicious...despite my hunger, I've agreed to get 50 Graham Crackers for him so he can build his dream house.
QuestInfo.2: I got all the Graham Cracker pieces (and resisted the temptation to eat them), returned to Mr. Kit Kat and he gave me something tasty?Banana Graham Pie. 2 of them!
QuestInfo.name: Graham Cracked

0.0: Hiya... think you can help an old man with building a Graham Cracker house?

yes.0: Thank you, kindly. My name is Mr. Kit Kat, I worked long and hard to find the perfect spot for my graham cracker house. Only the monsters keep eating all the pieces! I put one up and they steal it when my back is turned to eat it! They even laugh at me! I've had it. I need you to get 50 Graham Cracker Pieces and bring them back to me. Good luck!

no.0: Hey! Hands off! If you don't want to help, fine-but you can't eat them too!

1.0: All 50? Great! Now I can build my house! I'd like to thank you by offering you a little something I made for you. It's my special Banana Graham pie. Use it wisely and thanks again!

yes.0: Now I can build my house! Use it wisely and thanks again!

item.0: Got em all yet? No... don't think so-get a move on! In my heyday I would've been done by now!

QuestInfo.0: Can't believe its New Year's already! Looks like the Maple Administrator has something for me!
QuestInfo.1: Can't believe its New Year's already! Looks like the Maple Administrator has something for me!
QuestInfo.2: The Maple Administrator opened my present for me! Sweet!

4963.0: Mom and Dad need some help at home. I'd better go visit and see how I can help them.
4963.1: I visited Mom and Dad and they looked pretty happy to see me. They need a #bMouse#k for their new computer, and heard that Mr. Spot would have one. He's in Kerning City, so I'd better get a move on.
4963.2: I returned to Mom and Dad with the #bMouse#k, and they gave me #bAllowance#k. Now I can return to Mr. Spot and get a #bNexon Prepaid!#k
4963.name: Spot On : An Interesting Chore

yes.0: My pleasure. Happy New Year!

no.0: Heh, not really, but I can understand. Please come back when you want your gift.

1.0: This is for you.

yes.0: Come back when you are ready to receive your gift.

QuestInfo.0: It's New Year's! I should visit the Maple Administrator to get my present opened!
QuestInfo.1: It's New Year's! I should visit the Maple Administrator to get my present opened!
QuestInfo.2: The Maple Administrator opened my present for me! Sweet!

0.0: Hey there. I want to thank you for all your help with delivering those presents. Would you like me to open your present?

yes.0: Alright, let's open the present!

no.0: I understand. Come back when you are ready to receive your gift.

1.0: Here they are. Do you like what you see?

yes.0: I sincerely hope this year becomes your best year ever! Happy New Year, from MapleStory

QuestInfo.0: Mrs. Claus requires your help better go see her right away.
QuestInfo.1: Hunt monsters around the Maple World, and look for a special Mystery Gift Box! Once you find it, bring it to Mrs. Claus and she will help you open it to reveal what's inside! Make sure to come back daily, as Mrs. Claus can only help you once per day, and every box will bring something new! And if you manage to do the event for at least 20 days, you'll get a 1.5x EXP coupon (14 days).
QuestInfo.2: You did it! You found a Mystery Gift Box and with the help of Mrs. Claus, you were able to open it! Make sure to return tomorrow and open a new box!
QuestInfo.name: Christmas Advent Calendar

item.0: Have you found the mysterious Gift Box yet?

QuestInfo.0: Mom and Dad needs some help with Christmas preparations. I better go see them.
QuestInfo.1: Mom and Dad needs help gathering up food for the Christmas feast. In return for helping them I will get some allowance that will come to good use.
QuestInfo.2: I gathered up food for Mom and Dad, but it's not over yet. For the entire holiday they will need food. I should go see them in a while again.

item.0: You must be missing something, right?

QuestInfo.2: Hannah helped open up the box, and I got to receive what's inside it. Not bad!
QuestInfo.name: Festival of Lights - Blessing the Festival reward

0.0: No one knows what's inside this Hanukkah Present Box. Would you like to find out for yourself?

QuestInfo.0: I see Jacob, the garden caretaker over there! Why does he look so worried? Maybe I can lend him a hand.
QuestInfo.1: I talked with Jacob, who's trying to expand his garden. He's sent me to gather #b25 Cherry Blossom seeds#k, #b10 Silk Feathers#k and #b10 Leather#k. I've heard that Sakura celions might have the blossom seeds. In return for this, he's agreed to give me some high-quality potions. \nI bet they taste delicious...
QuestInfo.2: I got the materials that Jacob needed to expand the garden. He mentioned he might have more work for me if I needed it. I'll pay him a visit soon!
QuestInfo.name: Amoria : The Sakura Garden 1

0.0: ...Hello, how's it going, my friend? If I could steal a moment of your time, I have a most interesting quandary concerning my Sakura Garden. Do you have a moment to spare?

yes.0: Fabulous! My name's Jacob and I run the Sakura Garden. I'm looking to expand the garden with some more trees and nice, leather sofas. However, I'm rather lacking in the materials department. A well-traveled being such as you should have no problem gathering #b25 Cherry Blossom Seeds#k, #b10 Silk Feathers#k and #b10 Leather#k. The Cherry Blossom Seeds come from Sakura Cellions. I recall seeing a few over in the Purple Plains area of Amoria, so you may want to check over there. The Silk Feathers are fairly rare, but I've heard through the grapevine that Jr. Lioners tend to shed them upon demise. Bring them back to me, and I'll give you some of my very best potions stock!

no.0: Ah, I understand. We are all stones in the river of time, my friend. If you change your mind, I'll be here.

1.0: Fine job! These will fit perfect for the garden. As promised, here are the potions. Enjoy! I've got another task for you when you're ready.

yes.0: Thanks again for your assistance. Incidentally, I need some more help if you've got a moment.

item.0: How funny! You could make an easy living as a jester, coming back before the task was finished. You've amused me, now head back out there and get the #b25 Cherry Blossom Seeds#k, #b10 Silk Feathers#k and #b10 Leather#k! I'll be waiting.

QuestInfo.0: Jacob mentioned he'd need more help. Perhaps I should pay him a visit?
QuestInfo.1: I went to see Jacob again, and his Sakura Garden is just about done. He wants to do something special for the first guests, so I've agreed to provide #b20 White/Purple Gift Boxes#k, #b10 Lupin Dolls#k and #b10 Toy Baby Seals#k. Shouldn't be too tough, and he's mentioned something special if I finish...
QuestInfo.2: I finished getting everything for Jacob and returned to him for my reward-#bBlossom Juice#k! It tastes great!
QuestInfo.name: Amoria : The Sakura Garden 2 - Finishing Touches

0.0: ...Ah, I must thank you for your assistance with the Cherry Blossoms, which are growing nicely-and the sofas, which look magnificent. I do have one other task for you if you're up to it.

yes.0: Excellent, excellent! Well, to celebrate the opening of the new Sakura Garden, I've decided to give away some presents. As you demonstrated such combat prowess last time, I'm sure acquiring #b20 White/Purple-ribbon gift boxes#k, #b10 Lupin Dolls#k and #b10 Toy Baby Seals#k should be a simple twist of the sword for you! You might want to try Pink Teddies for the gift boxes, the Lupin Dolls and Toy Baby Seals should be easier to find. I have something special for you this time around.

no.0: That's unfortunate... you were a fantastic worker. Well, should you reconsider, you know where to find me!

1.0: A fine job, my friend! You've accomplished a task of the highest order! I want you to take this #bBlossom Juice#k as your hard-earned reward. You have my gratitude...

yes.0: You're assistance has proven invaluable, my friend. Thanks again!

item.0: Hmm, your satchel appears to have a hole in it my friend, when you sew it up, gather the rest and head back here.
