QuestInfo.0: I hear Maple Admin wants my help with something... Supposedly it has to do with the New Year! I'd better hurry!
QuestInfo.1: Maple Admin told me about the snowstorm and losing a gift she had intended to give me. I better go see her right away, to better understand how to retrieve the lost gift...
QuestInfo.2:
Maple Admin explained the situation.

I need to go see King #bAbdullah#k of Ariant, but before I do so, I first need to pick out a Horoscope costume from the Cash Shop, consisting of #bHoroscope Boots#k, #bHoroscope Overall#k, and a #bHoroscope Hat#k.

The hat was of utmost importance, and I better choose it very carefully...
QuestInfo.name: A Happy Maple New Year!

0.0:
Hi there #h #, perfect timing!

You see I was in the middle of delivering a batch of presents to all of you Maplers when I got caught in this terrible snow storm...
0.1:
Your present was unfortunately lost in the storm and it has been very difficult to track it down. With the help of my team, I have analysed the available evidence in an attempt to figure out which monster stole it from us.

We are not certain where it disappeared to, but I believe I know someone who may have the information we need...
0.2: If you are willing to help come talk to me when you are ready.

1.0: So you came after all! I was beginning to think you didn't care about your present, ha...!
1.1: As I mentioned earlier, there is someone that might have the information we need to in order to find your lost present...
1.2: You must pay a visit to the King of Ariant, #bAbdullah VIII#k. Now, you may not have known this, but the King is very superstitious, and around this time of the year he will refuse to see you unless you come dressed appropriately.
1.3:
What you must do is the following:

Go into the Cash Shop and pick out a Horoscope costume.

You must equip yourself with a #bHoroscope Overall#k, #bHoroscope Boots#k, and the most important one... listen carefully now...

There are many different #bHoroscope Hats#k in the Cash Shop and each one is special in its own way. Whichever hat you choose, know that your choice will affect the stars, and perhaps fate itself. Supposedly it has something to do with the Astral Plane...

So, choose carefully!
1.4:
... You got all of that now?

Go buy #bHoroscope Boots#k, #bHoroscope Overall#k, and a #bHoroscope Hat#k. Equip them and get ready for your meeting with King Abdullah.

no.0:
I will say it once more.

Go buy #bHoroscope Boots#k, #bHoroscope Overall#k, and a #bHoroscope Hat#k from the #rCash Shop#. Equip them and go and see King #bAbdullah#k in his palace in Ariant.

QuestInfo.0: #b#m221000000##k를 지키고 있는 #b#p2050011##k이 요새 먹고 싶은 게 있다는데…
QuestInfo.1: 언제나 딱딱한 분위기의 #m221000000#… 출동을 하고 싶지만 안 시켜준다고 투덜거리는 #p2050011#을 만났다. 임무가 지겨워서인지 #p2050011#은 빙수가 먹고 싶다고 한다. #b#m209000000##k에 맛있는 빙수를 만들 수 있는 재료가 있다고 하는데… #m209000000#까지 가는 방법은 #b#p1022101##k가 알고 있다고 한다.
QuestInfo.2: #p2001000#에게 #p2050011#의 사정을 이야기하자,  #p2001000#는 눈사람들에게서 눈뭉치를 구해다 주기로 했다. …눈사람들에게 그런 짓을 해도 되는 거야? 어쨌든 조금 있다가 가 보기로 하자.
QuestInfo.name: 케빈의 빙수 재료

0.0: 아아. 지겨운 경비 임무… 왜 출동을 안 시켜주는 건지 모르겠네… 에잇. 졸릴 때는 시원한 게 제일이지. 빙수라도 먹어야… 그거 아세요? 1년에 한 번 열리는 #b#m209000000##k의 눈은 다른 곳의 눈과는 다르대요. 훨씬 더 깨끗해서 그냥 눈을 먹어도 마치 설탕처럼 달다고 그러더라고요. 그걸로 빙수를 만들면 진짜 맛있다고 하던데…
0.1: 혹시 시간이 있으시다면 #m209000000#에 가서 그 #b특별한 눈뭉치#k를 좀 구해다 주시겠어요? 전 임무 때문에 움직일 수가 없어서…

yes.0: 오오! 정말 감사해요! 임무에 바쁜 저를 대신해서 #m209000000#까지 가 주시겠다니, 당신은 정말 친절하신 분이에요. 이 기쁜 마음을 어떻게 표시해야 할지!

no.0: 에… 혹시 당신도 임무 중? 바쁘시다면 어쩔 수 없지요, 뭐… 하아. 임무는 지겨워...

1.0: #m209000000#에 잘 왔네. 우리 마을에서 즐거운 시간 보내라고~ 응? 친구의 부탁으로 #m209000000#까지 왔다고? 좋은 젊은이로군. 착한 아이니 선물을 주도록 하지~

yes.0: 하지만 어쩐다지? 이 마을의 눈뭉치는 맛있기로 유명하거든. 미리 예약을 하지 않으면 구할 수가 없는데...
yes.1: 음… 이 기간을 놓치면 다시 일 년을 기다려야 할 테니… 좋아. #b#t04031428##k를 주도록 하지. 저기 있는 눈사람 녀석들에게서 약간만 달라고 할 테니, 조금만 기다려 보게나.

npc.0: 이왕이면 서둘러 주세요! 그 동안 전 빙수에 넣을 시럽과 과일을 준비할게요! #m209000000#까지 가는 방법은 #b#p1022101##k가 알고 있을 거예요~

QuestInfo.0: #p2050011#의 부탁을 전달하자 #p2001000#는 #t04031428#를 구해주겠다고 말했는데...
QuestInfo.1: 다행히도 마음씨 좋은 #p2001000#가 #t04031428#를 공짜로 주었다. 이제 이걸 #b#p2050011##k에게 다시 가져다주면 되겠군… 평범한 눈하고 크게 다르지 않아 보이는데, 이게 정말 맛있을까?
QuestInfo.2: #p2050011#에게 #t04031428#를 가져다주었다. 이미 과일에 시럽까지 준비해놓고 기다린 #p2050011#… 도대체 임무는 언제 하는 걸까?
QuestInfo.name: 클리프가 준 빙수 재료

0.0: 자, 이게 바로 #m209000000# 특제 빙수 재료! #b#t04031428##k라네. 여기다 시럽을 잔뜩 뿌려서 먹으면 황홀할 정도로 맛있는 특제 빙수 탄생이지. 하지만 더는 줄 수 없어. 더 이상 줬다가는 눈사람들이 서 있기도 힘들어질 테니까...

yes.0: 특별한 맛이 나는 눈이라고 해서 녹지 않는 것은 아니니, 녹아버리기 전에 가져가서 먹도록 하게나. 맛있게 먹길 바라겠네~

no.0: 으응? 애써 여기까지 구하러 와서 안 가져 가겠다고? 아쉽지 않나? 눈사람들에게야 다행이지만….

1.0: #m209000000#의 눈은 어떤 특별한 맛이 날까? 그냥 얼음하고는 비교하기도 힘든 맛이겠지? 기대된다~

yes.0: 와아! 이게 바로 #m209000000#에서 온 #b#t04031428##k군요! 보기에도 평범한 눈과는 뭔가 달라 보여요! 눈이 아니라 설탕처럼 달 것 같아! 정말 고맙습니다!

npc.0: 서두르지 않으면 눈이 녹아버린다네. 그런데 누구한테 갖다 주는 거라 그랬더라?

item.0: 시럽하고 과일은 준비를 다 했는데… 눈뭉치는 언제 도착하는 걸까?

lost.0: 뭐? 눈뭉치를 잃어버렸다고? 그러니까 조심했어야지! 지금은 눈뭉치를 더 주겠지만, 이제부터는 제발 주의해 주게나. 더 이상 눈을 주다가는 눈사람들이 남아나질 않을 거라고.

yes.0: 그럼 맛좋은 사료를 10개만 사서 클리프 할아버지께 가주세요. 맛좋은 사료를 먹으면 루돌프들도 힘이 나서 크리스마스 선물 배달을 더 잘 할 수 있을 거예요. 그럼 부탁드릴게요~

yes.0: 무릉이라는 곳을 알아? 오시리아에서도 가장 특이한 마을 중에 하나인데, 무릉 옆에 있는 백초 마을이라는 곳에 데비존이 있어. 예전에는 오시리아 전체를 주름잡던 해적이지만 지금은 힘 빠진 잔챙이일 뿐이니 지금이라면 녀석을 무찌를 수 있어.
yes.1: 오래 전 친구가 바다를 여행하면서, 데비존과 마주친 적이 있어. 그 친구는 그냥 여행자였을 뿐이었는데 데비존에게 무척 괴롭힘을 당했지. 그러니까 바다 여행 같은 것은 가지 말라고 그렇게 말했는데... 어쨌든 네가 그 친구의 복수를 해 줘. 부탁할게.

no.0: 싫다면 어쩔 수 없겠지. 대신 복수를 부탁하고 싶었는데… 하는 수 없군. 데비존에게 저주라도 걸어볼까?

quest.0: 아직 데비존을 처치하지 못했잖아? 저주를 걸어 버리기 전에 복수를 완료해 줘! 백초마을의 #b#p2094000##k에게 가면 데비존의 위치를 알 수 있을 거야.

0.0: Okay... I know it's a little too early to ask, but will you be my date? Wait wait, that's too cheesy. Hmm... hey there, I like you a lot, would you be my Valentine? Hmmm, that doesn't sound like me either... whoa, were you watching me the whole time? That was embarassing. What was I doing? Well... I actually took a liking to this girl not too long ago, and I want her to be my Valentine, but I don't know how to say it. The problem I have right now is that I am stuck here, doing my work, and I can't go visit her right now. Can you do me a huge favor, just this one time?

yes.0: Thank you so much. The favor I am about to ask you is simple, actually. I can't leave this place, but I want to really do something for Maya. yes.1: I feel like this is my chance, you know. To make this a reality, I want you to go see #b#p2041017##k and make one #b#t04140100##k for Maya. Once you have the chocolate ready, head over to Henesys and give it to her for me.

no.0: Oh no... if I don't ask her today, she might find someone else!!! Noo!!!

QuestInfo.2: 밍밍부인은 수박을 가져다 주었다. 너무 좋아하는 밍밍부인... 시원한 수박이 그녀에게 무척 필요했던 모양이다.
QuestInfo.name: 수박이 먹고 싶은 밍밍부인

0.0: 꺄~ 반가워. 마침 도움이 필요했는데 잘 왔어! 밍밍부인이 더운 날씨에 축제 준비를 하느라 너무 힘들어 하셔. 그래서 내가 깜짝 선물을 보내고 싶은데, 네가 좀 도와줄래?

yes.0: 얼마 전부터 박첨지의 수박밭에 호걸이 쳐들어와 수박을 가져가려고 한대. 그래서 박첨지는 내게 호걸들이 수박을 못 가져가도록 막아달라고 했어. 지금 호걸들은 마법에 걸려 원두막 주위를 맴돌기만 하고 있어. 후훗!
yes.1: 네가 메이플 운영자님께 수박을 선물하고 싶거든, 호걸들 몰래 #b박첨지의 수박#k을 #b5개#k 정도 가지고 와서 #b밍밍부인#k께 가져가 줘. 수박밭을 지켜주는 대신 박첨지도 그 정도는 가져가도 좋다고 했으니까, 걱정하지 말고.
yes.2: 잠시 후 나에게 말을 걸면 박첨지의 수박밭으로 보내줄게. 호걸들에게 들키기만 해도 수박밭에서 쫓겨나니까 조심해야 해.

no.0: 시원한 수박이라도 드시면 괜찮으실 텐데...

1.0: 더운 날씨 때문인지 축제를 준비하는 일이 너무 힘드네요. 앗! 저를 위해 선물을 가져오셨다고요?

yes.0: 정말 먹음직스러운 수박이군요. 잘 먹겠어요. 그리고 #b두시간#k에 한번 정도씩 수박을 가져다 주시면 더위를 잊을 수 있을 것 같군요. 부탁드려요.

QuestInfo.1:
대체 달은 어떻게 생긴거죠? 마을 어딘가에 보름달이 보인다고 했는데.. 보름달 가까이 가면 #i2430031:#를 더블클릭하여 달사진을 찍어오자.

사진찍는데, 실패했다면 #b아기 월묘#k에게 부탁하여 폴라로이드를 다시 얻을 수 있다.
QuestInfo.2: 달사진을 보고 신기해 하는 월묘는  달사진을 보자 매우 기뻐했다. 하루에 한번씩 아기 월묘를 찾아가서 사진을 찍어주자.
QuestInfo.name: 달은 어떻게 생겼죠?

0.0: 아휴~ 궁금해. 궁금해요. 뭐가 그렇게 궁금하냐고요? 저는 달을 제대로 본 적이 없어요. 왜냐면 달에서 태어나 여태 그 곳에서 살고 있어서 제대로 볼 수 없었죠. 그래서 이곳으로 내려왔는데.. 도무지 보이질 않네요.
0.1: 대체 달은 어떻게 생긴거죠? 여행자님께서 알려주시겠어요?

yes.0: 제가 드린 #b#t2430031##k는 소비창을 열어보시면 있을거에요. 마을 어딘가에서 밝은 보름달을 보게 되면 가까이 가서 #b인벤토리(단축키 I)#k를 열고  #i2430031:# #b#t2430031##k를 더블클릭하세요. 그러면 기타창에 #b달사진#k이 생길거에요. 달사진이 시간이 지나 현상이 되어 선명해 지면 그 때 저에게 가져와 주세요.

no.0: 제가 불쌍하지도 않으신가요? (..훌쩍..)

yes.0: 와~ 정말 제가 제일 가지고 싶어하던 달사진이 맞네요! 달사진을 아주 많이 가지고 싶어졌어요! 내일 또 저를 찾아오셔서 달사진을 찍어주셔야해요!

QuestInfo.1:
그림 그리기는 좋아하지만 색칠하기에는 서툰 카산드라가 레인보우위크에 사용할 무지개 그림을 마저 완성해 달라고 부탁했다. 천하의 카산드라도 못하는 일이 있다니... 7색의 크레파스는 가가가 가지고 있다고 하는데 카산드라의 부탁이라고 솔직하게 말하면 크레파스를 안 빌려줄지도 모른다. 

또, 요일마다 빌려주는 크레파스의 색이 다르다는데 무슨 수로 크레파스를 빌려서 그림을 완성하지?
#b
- 월요일 : 빨간색
- 화요일 : 주황색
- 수요일 : 노란색
- 목요일 : 초록색
- 금요일 : 파란색
- 토요일 : 남색
- 일요일 : 보라색
#r* 특별히 10월31일, 11월1일에는 원하는 색을 빌릴 수 있다.

0.1: 메이플 월드의 최고의 부호 골드리치의 보물창고에 무슨 돼지가 나타나서 보물을 마구 먹어치우고 있다나봐. 그래서 골드리치가 그 돼지들을 처리해 주었으면 하더군. #b#h0#!#k 뭐. 네가 미더운 건 아니지만 뭐 딱히 도와줄 사람이 없으니 생각있으면 한번 가보겠어? 혹시 알아? 보물을 얻을 수 있을지...단, 소비창은 1칸이상 비어있어야해!

no.0: 보물에 관심이 없다면야 뭐.

yes.0: 내가 가지고 있는건 #t2430007#밖에 없어. 하지만 몬스터 들에게서 얻을 수 있는 #b#t3994102#, #t3994103#, #t3994104#, #t3994105##k를 모은다음 내가 준 #b#t2430007##k을 더블클릭하면 골드리치의 보물창고으로 갈 수 있는 #b#t2430008##k을 만들 수 있을거야. 단,골드리치의 보물창고에서 돌아올 때는 가까운 마을로 오게 될거야.

0.2: Many people valiantly tried to keep the Black Mage from ruining their lives, but they were not strong enough. QuestInfo.0: Your training continues. You must keep progressing until the Black Mage is defeated once and for all. You should ask #b#p1201000##k what to do next.
QuestInfo.1:
#p1201000# says you can only train so much in #m140000000# and suggests you venture to #bVictoria Island#k. 0.0: In order to become stronger, you must experience more worldly things, which means you should expand your horizon by leaving this island. Staying here in #m140000000# will only get you so far.
0.1: Press #bW#k to open the world map. You'll see the whole world that you have forgotten, the world which you had fought so hard to save. Of all the places listed here, you should…
0.2: ...head over to #bVictoria Island#k first. There you'll be able to meet new people, battle different types of monsters, and gain invaluable experiences. Since you have lost all of your memory, your mind should be a blank canvas right now. Use this experience to soak up as much as you can, so that the next time you face the Black Mage, you will be able to look at him in the eye and not even flinch.

yes.0: There's actually a person there in Victoria Island that should be able to help you on your journey. Mr. Truth, or #b#p1002104##k, as he's called by the outside world, should be there. He's an #bInformation Dealer#k in #m104000000#. Take this letter, and he'll recognize you at once.
yes.1: Finding #b#m104000000##k in Victoria Island is easy. Exit the town to the right, then walk past the snowy forest and you'll see a small #bharbor#k which the penguins operate. There, strike a conversation with #b#p1200003##k and get on board.
yes.2: I notified #p1200003# in advance not to charge you a fee, since it's your first time. Once the ship reaches #m104000000#, find your way towards #b#m104000004##k where you'll find #p1002104#.
yes.3: I'll be waiting for you here, hoping that the next time I see you, you'll be that much stronger and more powerful than before.

1.0: Are you here to buy some valuable information? Hmmm? Is this… #t4032338#? Are you from #m140000000#? But the only human being that lives there is #p1201000#... Are you from somewhere else? Wait, no other person would dare to go there... so how did you...? Wait. Let me read this letter first.

yes.0: …I can't believe it. I'm standing in front of a hero. I used to live on that island myself, and I also used to believe the prophecy, but… oh my goodness. #p1201000#'s wishes have finally come true. What? You want to know what I was just talking about?
yes.1: After discovering the Book of Prophecy, our race has been bracing for your inevitable resurrection for hundreds of years… all in that tiny island with nothing but ice… but the hero never came, and we've been slowly losing our faith in the prophecy.
yes.2: In the end, most people left #m140000000#, tired of waiting for the prophecy that never came true. I just hope you don't blame them for leaving. They had to do what they had to do, you know. But, that being said…
yes.3: #p1201000# was the one person that never lost hope, and stayed in #m140000000# long after everyone else left, holding onto the belief that the hero will someday come back and save us. Even after her #bolder brother#k left the island. That's one stubborn kid, I tell you.
yes.4: But now that you're here, that stubborness has been rewarded. Thank you for coming back. Now I can look #p1201000# in the eye again. I have felt so bad for not being of any support to her, even though we are cousins.
yes.5: Just tell me what you want to do, and I'll be there to help. Not just because you're the hero in our eyes, but also because you've validated #p1201000#.

npc.0: You still haven't gone to #m104000000##k in #bVictoria Island? Just head east past town until you reach the #bharbor#k, then get on board the ship. The first ride will be free, so no worries there.

The one condition was that I could never leave the continent.  Ever.  I agreed without hesitation.

1.0: I remember way back, when I still lived in Kerning City; I had a dream...or perhaps a nightmare.  I saw everything working in a twisted sense of order, everyone in the Maple World had a vacant look upon their face, and the sky itself had turned black.  I saw a terrifying beast, large, powerful, with endless arms.  I saw pure misery - nothing could match its strength.  It had taken over the Maple World.  I remember seeing my friends as slaves to this horrible beast, and I remember the voice which told me I could stop it.
1.1: The next thing I knew, I stood in this very spot.  Subani helped me construct the city, the spirit's light growing dimmer with each task of strength.  Finally, when the city was finished, Subani told me that I could not tell a soul of what I knew, until the time was right. I had to let things happen as if I knew nothing.  Then, Subani was gone...vowing to return when most needed.  To see you standing here before me proves that you have the strength, courage and honor to be a new hero of Masteria. The storm is still coming, but I like our chances with you around.

yes.0: So relax for the time being, you've certainly earned it.  I have a feeling our adventures here are just getting started!

How can you let your own child die of hunger?

yes.2: Anyway, here is your reward, as promised. Sit on it, give it away, or use it for firewood. Whatever the case, I'm just glad you didn't become a victim of this cruel twist of fate. What a tragic story. It really is.

0.0: Forgive me, but I have one last request...  Please talk to \n#bCecilia#k. She was the caretaker of my beloved Rose Garden. I'm certain she must be very lonely.\r\n#fNpc/2162000.img/stand/0#

yes.0: Thank you. Just have a word with her, would you?

no.0: Is it too much to ask?

1.0: Hm? Who are you? What would a living person like you be doing here?
1.1: I bet Ifia put you up to this... She's always had such a good heart. And I suppose you do, too. It gets...rather lonely around here.
1.2: This place used to be so beautiful. His Highness gave this place to Ifia as his gift, but just like the rest of this accursed castle, it's fallen to the monsters.
1.3: I spent my life caring for this place. To see the garden trampled so, it just...it makes my blood boil! Or it would, if I had any.

yes.0: Let this be a lesson to you. Appreciate the beauty in your life, because who knows what will happen to it when you pass on. And if you're unlucky like me...you get to see it destroyed firsthand.

npc.0: Please give Cecilia my regards.

QuestInfo.0: Talk to Cecilia, the caretaker of the Rose Garden.
QuestInfo.1: Cecilia wants you to enter the Rose Garden to obtain roses to give to Ifia. You can only enter the Rose Garden once per day so make sure you are fully prepared before going in, and don't forget your Bug Catching Nets, just in case!
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the rose bouquet to Ifia. Cecilia will want to keep Ifia happy, so return to Cecilia each day to obtain more rose bouquets!
QuestInfo.name: The Queen's Bouquet

0.0: Sorry, I don't mean to be so gloomy. You were nice enough to come visit me, after all.
0.1: You know, this place used to have the most lovely roses in the kingdom, but after the eternal winter set on...well, you can imagine what happened.
0.2: Do you know who I really feel bad for? The kids. So many children got caught in the war and chaos. They didn't deserve that, and yet they got the worst of it. Their souls now lay trapped for eternity within the Rose Garden.
0.3: You must be quite strong to come all this way. Hmm... I have an idea.. Ifia doesn't know how bad things really are here at the Rose Garden. If you could deliver her some flowers from the Rose Garden, I reckon that would really cheer her up.
0.4: The thing is, the roses that currently grow withini the Rose Garden are frozen and lack any essence of life. However, if we can free some of the trapped souls, we can use their Freed Soul Crystals to infuse with the roses to restore that essense of life.
0.5: Ifia will only be convinced that all is well with the Rose Garden if she can feel the scent of fresh roses. Are you up to the task?

yes.0:
Wonderful! I'll only be able to let you into the Rose Garden #ronce per day#k, so make sure you are fully prepared before going in. Oh, one more thing, you might be lucky enough to come across Golden Bees while inside. Their Shiny Flower Powder is in high demand these days, so consider taking some Bug Catching Nets in with you. 

I'll be waiting for you inside the Rose Garden when you are ready.

no.0: Oh. That's a pity. Well...thanks for keeping me company, at least.

1.0: Once we get the flowers from the Rose Garden, we should deliver them to Ifia quickly before they deteriorate. You can only enter the Rose Garden once per day so make sure you are fully prepared before going in, and don't forget your Bug Catching Nets, just in case!

yes.0: Wow! Is this not the most beautiful bouquet? Cecilia is such a wonderful woman. I still remember teaching her to care for the flowers. The castle staff said it was beneath me, but I could not resist tending the garden when I had the chance. I'm glad to see the Rose Garden is still producing the best flowers!

QuestInfo.1: According to Mr. Bouffon, you can travel back in time through #bHelios Tower (101st Floor), Broken Gate of Time#k in Ludibrium. Try traveling back in time using the Broken Gate of Time.
QuestInfo.2: Travel to the past through the #bBroken Gate of Time at Helios Tower (101st Floor)#k.
QuestInfo.name: Invitation to Ellin Forest

0.0: Hello! So, how's life? Anything exciting happening? No? Well, I could tell that just by looking at you. But fret not, I've got something exciting for you... really exciting in fact, if you're interested.
0.1: Oh, you are? Fantabulous! After we assembled the Piece of Cracked Dimension, something utterly bizarre happened! As you know, the two towers that hold up Ludibrium, control the flow of time. However, the formation of the Piece of Cracked Dimension must have sent ripples throughout space and time, and caused one of the towers to malfunction. It's so bad, in fact, that we heard rumors of people slipping back through time there, to the past!
0.2: Now, why am I telling you all this? Heh, no reason, really. I just enjoy seeing everyone mess around recklessly with the fabric of space and time. What's the worst that could happen, we all go ka-boom? Hahahaha... Now then, the #e#bBroken Gate of Time on the 101st Floor of Helios Tower#k#n is your ticket to the past. It's up to you if you want to use it, never know when the tower might start working properly again! Have fun now!

QuestInfo.0: You arrived in a lush forest after passing through the #bBroken Gate of Time#k. Is this the past? See if anyone can confirm where...or when...you are.
QuestInfo.1: Yuris looked perfectly normal, but the more you talk to her, the stranger she seems. Maybe you should find someone easier to talk to. Try that #e#bLoha#k#n person whom Yuris mentioned.

QuestInfo.0: Alfonse Green seems to be in distress.  Maybe I should travel to Cloud Park in Orbis and find out why.
QuestInfo.1: Alfonse Green has had his Cupid's Arrows stolen by the monsters around the Orbis Cloud Park. He intended to deliver them to all the Nanas around Maple World for Valentine’s Day this year.  My task is to get them back and deliver 10 Cupid's Lost Arrow to each Nana.  Looks like I will need 60 Cupid’s Lost Arrow all together to help Alfonse Green.
QuestInfo.2: I successfully delivered 10 Cupid's Lost Arrow to each Nana around Maple World! Valentine’s Day is saved!
QuestInfo.name: Cupid's Lost Arrows

0.0: *Sob*... I was supposed to deliver my Cupid Arrows to the Nanas across Maple World for Valentine’s Day, but the monsters around here stole them from me.
0.1: Could you help get back the arrows from the monsters around Cloud Park for me and then deliver them to each Nana across Maple World?

yes.0: Really? Thank you... please bring 10 Cupid's Lost Arrow to each Nana. You can find Nana in Henesys, Perion, Kerning, Ellinia, Ludbrium and Orbis. Come back to me once you have delivered them all!

no.0: Oh… okay. I'll have to try and find them myself I suppose…

QuestInfo.0: #b#p9999807##k of Magatia, the oldest Alchemist around, is looking for help... Apparently he's searching for the Philosopher's Stone.
QuestInfo.1: I received a letter from #p9999807#, an Alchemist of Magatia. He said he's urgently looking for help with something. Any brave adventurer interested in the source of life, and who thinks they are up to the most dangerous of tasks and excursions, should heed his call, and pay a visit as soon as possible.
QuestInfo.2: #p9999807# the Alchemist of Life, as he refers to himself, believes in the Philosopher's Stone, the Elixir of Life. He believes it can be crafted or brewed, if the chemist only knows the right ingredients. During his long life, he has experimented with countless brews and concoctions, to no avail. He said at most his creations, all of which he tested on himself, made him feel revitalised and gave him a new spring in his step. He sounded rather desperate, asking me to help him find some very strange and rare ingredients. Supposedly he needs them for some ancient recipe he came across. He promised me great rewards, too, if I choose to help him.
QuestInfo.name: Reuel's Introduction

0.0: Hear ye, hear ye, Adventurers of Maple World! Heed my call! I, Reuel of Magatia am close to discovering something that will shake the very foundations of our world. Are you interested in learning more about the secrets of Life and Death? Then make haste, and come to me!

1.0: Aha! Another traveller who must have heard my call! Excellent, you look like a sturdy one. Are you willing to help me discover the path to eternal life? Then listen closely, for what I am about to tell you is known only by a few scholars of Alchemy!
1.1: The Philosopher's Stone, also known by many other names, but perhaps most famously as the Elixir of Life; is real.
1.2: It's as real as you and me, or this book here, or the sticky Cube Slimes downstairs. And better yet, it's out there! Problem is, it lay somewhere hidden, forgotten. The Sharenians had access to it, in ancient times, before their great downfall, as well as the people of Cristopher Crimsonheart, the Immortal Warrior.
1.3: Alas, its divine powers have been lost. But if it once existed, it means that it can exist again! And as the grand inventions and discoveries of Alchemists have shown, there is nothing which cannot be made by the hands of men!
1.4: I am old now, 111 to be exact, though I know I don't look it. I have recently made some remarkable progress, I must say, after a life of studying the ways of alchemy. Every day I can feel I am inching closer to the true recipe for the Elixir of Life! I am narrowing down the selection of items involved in brewing these strange and bizarre concoctions, and here's where you come into the picture.
1.5: Many of these items are rare and hard to come by, some grow in hard to reach places, such as the Crimsonwood Mountains, others down in the darkest depths of the ocean. Some are carried by fearsome monsters, and yet others are simply hard to find. No matter what, it is not a task for an old man like myself, and I am employing the help of strong Adventurers like you, to help in the acquisition of these precious ingredients! Are you feeling up to the task?
1.6: Excellent! Speak to me when you would like to begin!

QuestInfo.name: Mid-Autumn Festival!

0.0: Hiya #h #! Do you know what time it is? Why it's time for the yearly Mid-Autumn Festival, celebrated and loved by many around the world! It's time to celebrate the autumn harvest, and come together to pray and give thanks to the Gods for the plentiful harvests, and let's not forget: to observe the beautifully round and bright moon!
0.1:
The legend is told in many forms, and noone may quite agree on how it should be told... But the one I've always liked the most goes a little something like this...

A long time ago, in the very distant past when the Earth was young, a mythical Emperor ruled, and there were ten suns that took turns lighting up the Earth. The Emperor had declared that only one of them could play in the skies at a time, lest they cause irreparable damage to the Earth below. One day however, when the suns had grown weary of waiting for their turn, they all decided to rise into the sky in unison, all at once. This caused the Earth to become much too warm, and made life very difficult. Plants burned and people suffered. That is, until one day, when the great archer Hou Yi, took his bow, and shot down nine of the ten suns, so that only one remained in the sky!
0.2:
As a reward, the Queen Mother of the West, a Goddess who was married to the Emperor, gave Hou Yi an elixir of immortality. Hou Yi wanted to become immortal, but he was torn, as he did not want to leave his wife, Chang'e. Not able to make his mind up, he did not drink the elixir, and instead hid it in his house while he meant to ponder the decision.

One day, an apprentice broke into Hou Yi's and Change's house, and threatened Chang'e. He wanted her to hand the elixir over. She refused, and drank the elixir herself. Immediately, Chang'e flew out of the window of the house, and up towards the heavens above. She flew to the Moon, where he was rumored to have remained ever since. Upon learning what had happened, a great sadness came over Hou Yi, who started leaving his wife's favourite fruits and cake in their garden, as a sign of affection and forgiveness.
0.3: People believed Chang'e had remained on the Moon since that day, working with her sole companion, a Jade Rabbit, to produce another Elixir of Immortality. That is, until now! For Chang'e has blessed us with her presence in the Maple World! She waits for adventurer's in towns around the Maple World, and is said to accept offerings of Fruit and Mooncakes! Coincidentally, all monsters have begun dropping these exact items! What do you say, do you wish to participate in this event?

yes.0: Glad to hear it! If you collect enough Fruit Gifts and Mooncakes, and head over to Chang'e, Goddess of the Moon, she may bless us all with her divine powers! If we are lucky, that is! Now get hunting, sport!

no.0: Oh, well if you change your mind, come back and see me anytime!
